normal.explain: UNASSUMING (adj.)：態度謙遜而不刻意引人注意的。例句：Her unassuming manner contrasted with the elaborate costume.（她謙遜低調的態度與華麗戲服形成對比。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O N S _ I C U _ U S L Y (以明顯而引人注意的方式)
normal.explain: CONSPICUOUSLY (adv.)：以明顯而引人注意的方式。例句：He was conspicuously absent from the group photograph.（他明顯缺席團體照。）

normal.desc: 填空題：U N D _ R S T _ T E _ E N T (以較輕淡或克制措辭表達而產生效果)
normal.explain: UNDERSTATEMENT (n.)：以較輕淡或克制措辭表達而產生效果。例句：The review praises the scene’s understatement.（評論讚許這一幕的克制表達。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The route is shorter on paper, but that assumes the courtyard gate is open.
options: A. 路線圖尚未確認，所以無法知道庭院門在哪裡。
B. 庭院門會按紙本路線的長度決定開放時間。
C. 紙上路線較短，但前提是庭院門開著。
D. 庭院門開著，因此路線圖才印得比較小。
normal.explain: assumes指出較短路線所依賴的通行條件，不是地圖尺寸。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have made the labels clearer without making the underlying layout any less confusing.
options: A. 配置變得較清楚，因此標籤已可移除。
B. 標籤和配置都改善了，只差顏色尚未調整。
C. 標籤較模糊，所以必須靠配置來補救。
D. 標籤變清楚了，但配置本身仍令人困惑。
normal.explain: without ... any less否定配置困惑程度的改善，同時保留標籤的進步。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The blue route is intended for visitors; staff tend to use the service corridor instead.
options: A. 藍線為訪客規畫，員工通常改走服務走廊。
B. 藍線只供員工走，訪客應走服務走廊。
C. 員工傾向帶訪客一起走藍線後再進走廊。
D. 服務走廊改開放訪客後，員工才開始走藍線。
normal.explain: intended用途與tend實際習慣分述，未說員工帶路或制度變更。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The old street names survive in conversation even where the signs have been replaced.
options: A. 舊街名只保留在路牌，交談時已改用新名。
B. 交談內容已證明路牌更換並未實際進行。
C. 路牌依居民每次交談時使用的名稱而更換。
D. 即使路牌已更換，日常交談仍沿用舊街名。
normal.explain: survive in conversation說明口語慣用與路牌變動不同步。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not questioning the survey. I am questioning whether these are the measurements a walker needs.
options: A. 不是質疑測量本身，而是這些數據是否符合步行者需求。
B. 測量方法有誤，因此任何步行資訊都不可信。
C. 只要補做測量，就不再需要詢問步行者需求。
D. 步行者已提供全部數據，測量只是確認其正確性。
normal.explain: 區分資料可信度和對使用者目的的適切性，未否定測量。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We should not mistake the absence of a line for the absence of a path.
options: A. 實地道路是否存在，可由圖上線條長度判斷。
B. 不能因圖上沒畫線，就認定實地沒有路。
C. 圖上若有線，就能確認實地道路目前開放。
D. 圖上沒畫線，反而代表實地路徑特別寬。
normal.explain: absence對比地圖表述與實地存在；也不反向保證有線就開放。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is a more legible map, not necessarily a more faithful picture of the distances involved.
options: A. 地圖更易辨讀，不代表距離呈現更忠實。
B. 距離畫得更準確，但標籤比以前更難辨讀。
C. 由於更易辨讀，距離的準確度也已獲得證實。
D. 地圖只呈現距離，不再提供辨讀所需的標籤。
normal.explain: legible與faithful to distances為不同評價面向，not necessarily不等於距離一定錯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The alternative route is not an afterthought; it is the only one that works when the lift is out of service.
options: A. 電梯停用只是設計完成後才偶然發現的小問題。
B. 替代路線並非附帶應付，而是電梯停用時唯一可行路線。
C. 替代路線尚未想好，因此電梯停用就沒有路可走。
D. 替代路線只在電梯運作時可用，停用後須另規畫。
normal.explain: not an afterthought反對把替代路線視為事後附加；its必要性由停梯條件說明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: People are following the signs accurately. The difficulty is that the signs were designed around a route we no longer recommend.
options: A. 設計已按新路線更新，但人們還習慣走舊路。
B. 人們依標示走得太慢，所以設計者不再推薦步行。
C. 人們正確照標示走；問題是標示仍依已不建議的路線設計。
D. 人們誤讀了標示，因此才走上目前建議的路線。
normal.explain: following accurately排除使用者照做有誤，問題在標示所承接的過時路線。

normal.desc: 【推論】A campus map enlarges the central buildings and compresses the spaces between them. Its designer calls it a guide to connections, not a scale drawing. What does that distinction explain?
options: A. The campus itself has become more densely built.
B. Connections matter only when a visitor remains in the centre.
C. Distances cannot be read directly from the spacing shown.
D. Only the largest buildings are connected by paths.
normal.explain: 非比例圖可以保留連接關係，不能直接由圖上間隔推實際距離。

normal.desc: 【語用】The route is accessible, provided you approach it from the west. What does the qualification imply?
options: A. Western visitors are given priority over other visitors.
B. The route becomes accessible only after sunset.
C. An accessible approach is necessarily the shortest approach.
D. The approach is relevant to whether the route can be used.
normal.explain: provided引入條件；同一設施的不同進入方向可能有不同可用性。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The digital map is updated weekly; the wall display, less frequently. It is the latter that visitors tend to consult first. Which source is first consulted?
options: A. The wall display.
B. The weekly update notification.
C. The digital map.
D. A separate comparison of both versions.
normal.explain: latter指第二者wall display，更新頻率不決定實際先看哪個。

normal.desc: 【短文】A station replaces arrows with colour-coded routes. Visitors identify the colours easily but remain unsure where each route begins. What has the change failed to resolve?
options: A. Distinguishing one route colour from another.
B. Recognising whether the station has several routes.
C. Remembering the name of the station they entered.
D. Locating the point at which to join a route.
normal.explain: 顏色辨識已成功，未解的是各路線起點。

normal.desc: 【語意】The map is comprehensive in coverage but selective in detail. Which description preserves that contrast?
options: A. It includes the whole area while omitting some local features.
B. It depicts a small area with every feature drawn precisely.
C. It uses some areas to stand for places outside its scope.
D. It provides more local detail as its geographical coverage shrinks.
normal.explain: coverage是涵蓋範圍，selective detail是範圍內資訊有所選擇；未說縮小範圍的動態變化。

normal.desc: 【推論】A route marked as direct crosses a courtyard that is open only during office hours. The reviewer recommends qualifying the label. What needs to be made explicit?
options: A. Whether the courtyard has more than one entrance.
B. When that direct route is available.
C. How far the courtyard lies from the office.
D. Who originally chose the word direct.
normal.explain: direct並非一定不對，但依賴庭院開放時段，標籤需附可用條件。

normal.desc: 【短文】Residents call the alley Market Lane, although it appears under another name on official maps. A local guide prints both names. What is the guide trying to bridge?
options: A. Everyday usage and the formal naming system.
B. The alley’s current name and a predicted future name.
C. A pedestrian route and a parallel vehicle route.
D. Residents’ addresses and visitors’ accommodation details.
normal.explain: 兩個名稱對應在地慣用與官方系統，不必推定先後改名。

normal.desc: 【推論】After testing the signs with first-time visitors, the designer removes an instruction that staff had considered self-evident. Visitors had interpreted it in two different ways. What explains the removal?
options: A. Staff had mistaken a temporary sign for a permanent one.
B. Staff familiarity had concealed ambiguity in the wording.
C. Visitors had demonstrated that the route itself was closed.
D. The instruction had become unnecessary after staff training.
normal.explain: 熟悉場地者認為不言自明，新訪客卻有兩種解讀，揭露熟悉度掩蓋的歧義。

normal.desc: 【短文】An access map highlights step-free entrances but leaves the connecting paths unmarked. A reviewer notes that an entrance is useful only if a visitor can reach it. What is the underlying criticism?
options: A. The map includes entrances that should be reserved for staff.
B. A step-free entrance cannot be represented on a conventional map.
C. Isolated features are shown without the usable links between them.
D. The map makes entrances appear closer to one another than they are.
normal.explain: 入口資訊不等於全程可達，批評缺少串接路徑，不是否定無階差入口或地圖形式。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：在環境中辨識位置與尋找路線
normal.explain: wayfinding (n.)：在環境中辨識位置與尋找路線。例句：The hospital tested its wayfinding system with people on their first visit.（醫院找初次到訪者測試辨位導引系統。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：文字或圖示容易辨讀的程度
normal.explain: legibility (n.)：文字或圖示容易辨讀的程度。例句：Improved legibility does not by itself guarantee a useful route.（辨讀性改善本身並不保證路線實用。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：失去方向感的狀態
normal.explain: disorientation (n.)：失去方向感的狀態。例句：Identical corridors can create a sense of disorientation.（看起來相同的走廊可能讓人失去方向感。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：地形的形狀與高低起伏
normal.explain: topography (n.)：地形的形狀與高低起伏。例句：The map simplifies the topography but retains the steepest slopes.（地圖簡化了地形，但保留最陡的坡段。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：先前的熟悉感可能掩蓋標示的歧義。
normal.ans: PRIOR FAMILIARITY CAN OBSCURE A SIGN'S AMBIGUITY
normal.speak: prior familiarity can obscure a sign's ambiguity
normal.explain: Prior familiarity can obscure a sign's ambiguity (phr.)：先前的熟悉感可能掩蓋標示的歧義。。
normal.vocabId: R7:PRIOR FAMILIARITY CAN OBSCURE A SIGN'S AMBIGUITY

normal.desc: 請唸出：清楚的資訊在作決定的位置尤其重要。
normal.ans: CLARITY MATTERS MOST AT THE DECISION POINT
normal.speak: clarity matters most at the decision point
normal.explain: Clarity matters most at the decision point (phr.)：清楚的資訊在作決定的位置尤其重要。。
normal.vocabId: R7:CLARITY MATTERS MOST AT THE DECISION POINT

normal.desc: 請拼出：界線的劃分或標示（D 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: DEMARCATION (n.)：界線的劃分或標示。例句：The demarcation between the public path and the work area is unclear.（公共小路與施工區之間的界線標示不清。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：可以穿越或通過的（T 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: TRAVERSABLE (adj.)：可以穿越或通過的。例句：A path shown on the plan may not be traversable after heavy rain.（圖上畫出的路徑，大雨後可能無法通過。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：彼此相連的（I 開頭，14 個字母）
normal.explain: INTERCONNECTED (adj.)：彼此相連的。例句：The buildings are interconnected, but the connecting doors close at night.（建築物彼此相連，但相接的門夜間會關閉。）

normal.desc: 填空題：O B S C _ R E D (被遮擋而看不清的)
normal.explain: OBSCURED (adj.)：被遮擋而看不清的。例句：The sign was partly obscured by an open door.（路牌有一部分被打開的門遮住。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A M B _ G U _ U S (容許不只一種解讀的)
normal.explain: AMBIGUOUS (adj.)：容許不只一種解讀的。例句：The instruction is ambiguous about which entrance to use.（指示沒有清楚交代該使用哪個入口。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O _ T I _ U _ T Y (連續性；不中斷的銜接)
normal.explain: CONTINUITY (n.)：連續性；不中斷的銜接。例句：The proposal improves continuity between the riverside paths.（提案改善河岸步道之間不中斷的銜接。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The code prohibits officials from accepting gifts that could compromise impartiality.
options: A. 官員可接受所有外部饋贈，唯需如實申報價值。
B. 法規僅限制非營利機構向審查人員提供禮品。
C. 饋贈金額若低於規定標準即不被視為倫理事件。
D. 法規禁止公務人員收受可能損害公正立場之饋贈。
normal.explain: compromise impartiality 損害公正性，prohibits accepting 禁止收受。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The inspector general operates independently of the agency’s executive leadership.
options: A. 督察長獨立於該機構之高階行政領導層之外運作。
B. 督察長直接向各業務部門最高行政首長負責。
C. 機構領導層有權隨時終止督察長之調查行動。
D. 督察長僅在獲得法官授權後方能開展內部稽核。
normal.explain: operates independently of 體現監督機制的獨立運作架構。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Public consultation revealed significant reservations regarding the proposed zoning amendments.
options: A. 分區修訂委員會在諮詢前已正式簽署實施法令。
B. 公眾諮詢顯示民眾對擬議之土地分區修訂案多所保留。
C. 諮詢結果證實各界對分區修訂案展現壓倒性支持。
D. 市民要求即刻取消所有未來的都市公聽會程序。
normal.explain: significant reservations 對方案持重大保留與疑慮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Arbitrary enforcement undermines the perceived legitimacy of administrative rules.
options: A. 專斷恣意的執法將侵蝕行政規章在公眾眼中的合法性。
B. 行政規章必須具備絕對彈性以適應所有個案差異。
C. 專斷執法被證明能夠顯著提升公眾之法規遵從度。
D. 公眾對規章合法性之評價完全取決於執法罰鍰多寡。
normal.explain: arbitrary enforcement 專斷執法，undermines perceived legitimacy 侵蝕公信力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The distinction between advisory recommendations and binding statutory requirements must be upheld.
options: A. 行政機構有權自由將任何法定要求解釋為自願建言。
B. 諮詢性建言與具拘束力之法定要求之間的界線必須維持。
C. 所有諮詢建言自發布當日起即具備完全之法定拘束力。
D. 法定要求在遭遇執行阻礙時可自動降格為諮詢建言。
normal.explain: distinction must be upheld 堅持兩者界限不可混淆。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A superficial consensus often conceals profound disagreements regarding resource allocation.
options: A. 資源分配的爭議在簽訂協議後便已徹底煙消雲散。
B. 各部門寧願維持公開爭吵也不願尋求形式上之共識。
C. 表面上的共識往往掩蓋了關於資源分配的深刻分歧。
D. 達成共識即證明所有人對資源配置方案毫無異議。
normal.explain: superficial consensus 表面共識，conceals profound disagreements 掩蓋深刻歧異。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Institutional legitimacy depends not merely on statutory legality, but on perceived procedural justice.
options: A. 體制合法性完全由行政機關的預算規模與執行速度所決定。
B. 體制正當性不僅取決於法律合規，更取決於公眾所感知的程序正義。
C. 只要符合法定程序，公眾的主觀感受便與體制正當性無關。
D. 程序正義在面對法定成文法規時不具備任何獨立參考價值。
normal.explain: not merely ... but on 強調 procedural justice 程序正義之不可或缺。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The administration framed the reform as an efficiency measure, thereby diverting scrutiny from its redistributive impact.
options: A. 效率提升的承諾吸引了更多外部專家對分配衝擊的深入研究。
B. 社會各界一致認為效率改進是該改革方案唯一值得探討的面向。
C. 行政當局將改革包裝為效率提升，藉此轉移對其重分配衝擊的檢視。
D. 當局直言不諱地承認該改革方案旨在全面重構財富分配。
normal.explain: framed as ... diverting scrutiny 將其框定為效率，藉此轉移分配衝擊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Adjudicative discretion is essential to equity, yet unchecked discretion invariably invites charges of bias.
options: A. 為追求絕對公平，司法體系必須徹底剝奪所有法官的自由裁量權。
B. 受到嚴密監督的裁量權在司法實務中被證明完全無法實現實質正義。
C. 所有針對裁量偏差的指控均源自對成文法條文內容的錯誤解讀。
D. 裁量權對個案公平不可或缺，然而不受制約之裁量必然招致不公指控。
normal.explain: discretion essential to equity 裁量為公平所需，unchecked discretion invites bias 無制約則生偏私。

normal.desc: 【法規】The regulation distinguishes administrative penalties from criminal prosecution, assigning the former to the municipal inspectorate. Which authority handles administrative penalties?
options: A. The state criminal court.
B. An independent panel of citizens.
C. The national constitutional tribunal.
D. The municipal inspectorate.
normal.explain: the former 指前述第一者 administrative penalties，歸 municipal inspectorate。

normal.desc: 【政策】A policy amendment permits discretionary exemptions, provided the applicant demonstrates disproportionate hardship. What must an applicant demonstrate?
options: A. Disproportionate hardship resulting from the rule.
B. A clean record of prior compliance.
C. Endorsement from three municipal officials.
D. A commitment to fund alternative community projects.
normal.explain: discretionary exemptions 酌情豁免的必要前提為證明 disproportionate hardship。

normal.desc: 【文法】Were the board to approve the restructuring tomorrow, implementation ___ across six distinct phases.
options: A. had proceeded
B. would proceed
C. will proceed
D. has proceeded
normal.explain: Were the board to approve 為假設語氣倒裝，主句配 would proceed。

normal.desc: 【語用】The director praised the initiative as ambitious, though she questioned its institutional sustainability. What was her assessment?
options: A. She supported its vision while doubting its longevity.
B. She dismissed both the concept and the execution.
C. She confirmed that the funding was permanent and secure.
D. She urged other departments to duplicate the structure immediately.
normal.explain: 肯定其雄心（vision），但對體制永續性（longevity）保留質疑。

normal.desc: 【推論】An agency replaces peer review with algorithmic scoring for small grants, noting a reduction in processing times but an increase in identical appeal arguments. What trade-off is indicated?
options: A. Algorithmic scoring proved more expensive than anticipated.
B. Efficiency improved at the expense of individualized review.
C. Subjective bias was entirely eliminated without cost.
D. The total number of applications dropped precipitously.
normal.explain: 時效縮短但申訴論點趨同，顯示以犧牲個別化審查換取效率。

normal.desc: 【文義】The committee deemed the measure necessary but insufficient to curb regulatory capture. What was the verdict?
options: A. The proposed reform is counterproductive and harmful.
B. Regulatory capture cannot be addressed through legislation.
C. The step is helpful, yet further action is required.
D. The measure is redundant because capture has already ended.
normal.explain: necessary but insufficient 表示該步驟有益但仍需後續行動。

normal.desc: 【政策】The decree imposes reporting obligations on foreign subsidiaries, excepting those operating solely within free-trade zones. Which subsidiaries are exempt?
options: A. Enterprises employing fewer than one hundred personnel.
B. Those confined entirely to free-trade zones.
C. All subsidiaries established before the decree.
D. Subsidiaries whose parent companies are domestic.
normal.explain: excepting those operating solely within free-trade zones 僅排除保稅區企業。

normal.desc: 【批判】The report observes that institutional inertia, rather than explicit opposition, derailed the reform package. What stalled the reform?
options: A. A catastrophic shortfall in public revenues.
B. Contradictory directives issued by the executive branch.
C. Established organizational habits and reluctance to change.
D. Direct legal challenges brought by advocacy groups.
normal.explain: institutional inertia 指體制既有慣性與消極拖延，非明面反對。

normal.desc: 【語用】The chair remarked that while legal compliance had been verified, ethical defensibility remained an open question. What did the chair imply?
options: A. The organization should challenge the relevant statutes in court.
B. Compliance officers exceeded their designated authority.
C. The legal audit was flawed and must be conducted anew.
D. Lawfulness does not guarantee ethical acceptability.
normal.explain: 合乎法律不等於在倫理層面站得住腳（lawfulness does not guarantee defensibility）。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：官方司法或行政管轄權限範圍
normal.explain: jurisdiction (n.)：官方司法或行政管轄權限範圍。例句：The complaint falls outside the regulatory jurisdiction of this office.（該項投訴超出本辦公室的行政監管權限範圍。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：實務導向且講求實際成效的
normal.explain: pragmatic (adj.)：實務導向且講求實際成效的。例句：We adopted a pragmatic approach to resolve the contractual dispute.（我們採取實務導向的做法以化解合約糾紛。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：深思熟慮且經審慎評估的
normal.explain: deliberate (adj.)：深思熟慮且經審慎評估的。例句：The policy was a deliberate choice to mitigate systemic fiscal risks.（該政策乃是為減輕體制性財政風險而經深思熟慮之抉擇。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：法律成文法條明文規定的
normal.explain: statutory (adj.)：法律成文法條明文規定的。例句：The ministry failed to fulfill its statutory duty to publish the report.（該部會未能履行其公佈該報告之法定職責。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：自由裁量權必須具備制度性制約。
normal.explain: Discretion requires structural constraint (phr.)：自由裁量權必須具備制度性制約。。

normal.desc: 請唸出：體制的公信力極易遭受揮霍耗損。
normal.explain: Institutional credibility is easily squandered (phr.)：體制的公信力極易遭受揮霍耗損。。

normal.desc: 請拼出：官方正式廢除撤銷法令或合約（R 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: RESCIND (v.)：官方正式廢除撤銷法令或合約。例句：The governor moved to rescind the emergency directive last night.（州長昨晚採取行動以正式廢除該緊急行政命令。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：依據法律或官方程序對爭議進行裁決（A 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: ADJUDICATE (v.)：依據法律或官方程序對爭議進行裁決。例句：An independent tribunal was appointed to adjudicate the dispute.（一個獨立仲裁法庭獲指派以就該起爭端進行法律裁決。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：符合眼前權宜算計但未必合於道德的（E 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: EXPEDIENT (adj.)：符合眼前權宜算計但未必合於道德的。例句：The compromise was politically expedient though morally questionable.（這項妥協在政治上雖屬權宜之計，道德層面卻大有可議。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E R O G _ T I O N (對法律或公約義務的局部減損或免除)
normal.explain: DEROGATION (n.)：對法律或公約義務的局部減損或免除。例句：The state applied for a temporary derogation from the treaty provisions.（該國申請暫時免除履行部分條約義務條款。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R E _ O G A _ I V E (特定職位或統治機構專屬之特權)
normal.explain: PREROGATIVE (n.)：特定職位或統治機構專屬之特權。例句：Pardoning convicted offenders remains an executive prerogative.（赦免受刑定讞者依然屬於行政首長之專屬特權。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ E R _ E G _ U M (體制或政權交替期間之權力過渡空白期)
normal.explain: INTERREGNUM (n.)：體制或政權交替期間之權力過渡空白期。例句：The civil service maintained basic public order during the interregnum.（文官體系在政權過渡空白期維持了基本公共秩序。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A sound argument requires both formal validity and true premises.
options: A. 健全之論證既需形式上的有效結構，亦需實質真確之前提。
B. 形式有效之論證必然能確保其所有前提皆屬真確。
C. 論證之真偽完全取決於聽眾是否產生強烈情感共鳴。
D. 健全性在邏輯學上僅要求結論與講述者初衷相互契合。
normal.explain: sound argument 要求 formal validity 與 true premises 兩者兼備。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Epistemology investigates the nature, sources, and limits of knowledge.
options: A. 該學門主要探討古代統治者如何運用權謀維持政權。
B. 認識論深入探究知識的本質、來源及其界限所在。
C. 認識論專注於研究物質宇宙在物理層面的演化規律。
D. 認識論否定人類大腦具備掌握任何客觀知識之可能。
normal.explain: epistemology 核心命題：nature, sources, limits of knowledge。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The assertion that all swans are white was dismantled by a single counterexample.
options: A. 該反例被證明屬於實驗室人為製造的基因變異物種。
B. 科學界一致同意將該反例排除在天鵝物種分類之外。
C. 所有天鵝皆白之普遍宣稱，僅憑單一反例便遭徹底瓦解。
D. 單一反例在經驗科學中不足以動搖任何普遍法則。
normal.explain: counterexample 反例對全稱命題之決定性瓦解作用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The principle of parsimony favours the explanation that requires the fewest assumptions.
options: A. 解釋效能與模型內部的假設數量多寡在實務上毫無關聯。
B. 簡約原則傾向支持需要最少假設前提之理論解釋。
C. 最複雜且假設最多的學說必然具備最強之解釋效能。
D. 簡約原則要求科學家完全放棄使用任何未經證實的符號。
normal.explain: parsimony 奧坎剃刀原則：fewest assumptions 最少假設。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The historian demonstrated that the concept of individual privacy is historically contingent.
options: A. 隱私觀念的演變證明了人類道德水準隨著時間必然不斷進步。
B. 歷史研究已證實任何文明若欠缺現代隱私法制便無法維繫。
C. 歷史學家證明了個人隱私的概念在歷史進程中深具偶發性。
D. 個人隱私權自人類誕生起便被所有文明視為至高無上的美德。
normal.explain: historically contingent 表明並非永恆先驗，而是歷史條件之產物。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The author conflated necessity with sufficiency, derailing the logical force of the thesis.
options: A. 論文的邏輯力量因精確區分必要性與充分性而大獲讚賞。
B. 必要條件在嚴密推論中往往可直接視為充分條件予以處理。
C. 該混淆被評審委員會認為是開創全新邏輯範式的劃時代突破。
D. 作者混淆了必要條件與充分條件，削弱了論文的核心邏輯力量。
normal.explain: conflated necessity with sufficiency 混淆充分與必要條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The thesis relies upon a reductive materialism that trivializes qualitative consciousness.
options: A. 論文作者斷言主觀心靈體驗完全無法被還原為單純物理神經活動。
B. 質性意識在該研究中被確立為衡量物質宇宙存在的最高準則。
C. 該論文依賴還原唯物論，將質性意識經驗貶低為無足輕重的副產物。
D. 還原唯物論完美解釋了人類情感與藝術審美經驗的獨特價值。
normal.explain: reductive materialism 還原唯物論 trivializes qualitative consciousness。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Hermeneutic analysis reveals that no interpretation is entirely free from historical prejudice.
options: A. 讀者只要經過嚴密訓練，便能在閱讀時徹底清除所有歷史預設。
B. 歷史先見被證實乃是阻礙讀者理解任何古典文本之致命毒素。
C. 詮釋學的主要目標在於確立文本存在唯一的絕對客觀標準答案。
D. 詮釋學分析揭示，沒有任何文本解讀能夠完全超脫歷史先見之制約。
normal.explain: hermeneutic analysis 詮釋學揭示歷史先見（prejudice）之不可避免。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The fallacy of reification treats an abstract concept as though it were a concrete physical entity.
options: A. 具象化謬誤將抽象概念誤當作具體物理實體來對待與處理。
B. 具象化是現代哲學用以檢驗抽象概念客觀實在性之標準方法。
C. 所有物理實體在本質上皆應被視為人類語言發明之抽象範疇。
D. 將概念視為實體在理論物理學中已被證明能消除所有認識盲點。
normal.explain: fallacy of reification 概念實體化/具象化謬誤。

normal.desc: 【認識論】Empiricism asserts that all knowledge originates in sensory experience, whereas rationalism posits innate intellectual concepts. What is the fundamental divide?
options: A. The ultimate source of human knowledge.
B. Whether science should be funded by universities.
C. The grammatical structure of logical propositions.
D. Whether mathematics is applicable to astronomy.
normal.explain: 經驗論與唯理論之核心分歧在於知識的根本起源。

normal.desc: 【邏輯】An argument is formally valid if its conclusion follows necessarily from its premises, regardless of whether the premises are factually true. What does validity evaluate?
options: A. The moral intentions behind proposing the argument.
B. The logical connection between premises and conclusion.
C. The empirical accuracy of the factual statements.
D. The rhetorical charisma of the defending speaker.
normal.explain: 有效性（validity）純粹衡量前提與結論間之邏輯推導結構。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had the researchers accounted for attrition bias, their longitudinal findings ___ far more persuasive.
options: A. are
B. had been
C. would have been
D. will have been
normal.explain: Had the researchers accounted ... would have been 為與過去事實相反之倒裝句型。

normal.desc: 【深辨】The critique demonstrated that the proposed model was unfalsifiable, as it reinterpreted every contradiction as a special case. Why was the model criticized?
options: A. It relied exclusively on ancient geometric principles.
B. It insulated itself against empirical refutation.
C. It proved that all previous scientific models were wrong.
D. It required excessive computational power to execute.
normal.explain: 任何反證皆被強解為特例，使其在經驗上不可證偽（unfalsifiable）。

normal.desc: 【論點】The historian rejects technological determinism, arguing that inventions are shaped by prevailing social structures rather than dictating them autonomously. What is rejected?
options: A. The belief that historians should study ancient engineering.
B. The proposition that machines require human operators.
C. The claim that technology independently determines social history.
D. The view that social structures influence technological adoption.
normal.explain: 駁斥技術決定論（即科技獨立單向決定人類社會歷史之觀點）。

normal.desc: 【謬誤】To dismiss a philosopher’s ethical theory simply because she led an unconventional personal life is to commit an ad hominem fallacy. What makes this a fallacy?
options: A. Demanding empirical proof for metaphysical claims.
B. Assuming that ethical theories can never be applied in practice.
C. Confusing logical necessity with contingent historical fact.
D. Attacking the person’s character rather than the argument’s merits.
normal.explain: 訴諸人身謬誤：攻擊人格私德而非論辯理論本身之理據。

normal.desc: 【方法】A paradigm shift occurs not merely through incremental accumulation, but through a conceptual reconfiguration of existing data. What triggers the shift?
options: A. An administrative decree issued by the academy.
B. A sudden doubling of governmental research grants.
C. A fundamental change in the conceptual framework.
D. The physical destruction of older laboratory archives.
normal.explain: 典範轉移仰賴概念架構的根本重構，非單純資料量之遞增。

normal.desc: 【微差】The essay distinguishes between ontological claims regarding what exists and epistemological claims regarding how we know what exists. What is the scope of ontology?
options: A. The analysis of the cognitive faculties of memory.
B. The historical investigation of religious scriptures.
C. The technical measurement of physical constants.
D. The study of the fundamental nature of existence.
normal.explain: 本體論（ontology）探討存在本身，與探討認知途徑的認識論分立。

normal.desc: 【深辨】The critic argues that the author confuses an instrumental reason, which calculates means to an end, with substantive reason, which evaluates the ends themselves. What is the critique?
options: A. Means-end efficiency was mistaken for moral wisdom.
B. All human reasoning was declared fundamentally flawed.
C. Substantive goals were prioritized over technical execution.
D. Instrumental reason was rejected as completely useless.
normal.explain: 將工具理性（手段效率）誤認為實質理性（價值目的之反思）。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：探討知識起源、本質與界限的認識論
normal.explain: epistemology (n.)：探討知識起源、本質與界限的認識論。例句：Classical epistemology distinguishes between belief and justified knowledge.（古典認識論嚴格區分主觀信念與經證成之真知識。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：與詮釋理解及文本解讀方法相關的
normal.explain: hermeneutic (adj.)：與詮釋理解及文本解讀方法相關的。例句：The court adopted a hermeneutic approach to constitutional text.（法院對憲法文本採取了深刻的詮釋學解讀方法。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：在經驗科學上具備可被反證推翻性質的
normal.explain: falsifiable (adj.)：在經驗科學上具備可被反證推翻性質的。例句：A rigorous theory must yield empirically falsifiable predictions.（嚴謹的科學理論必須能產出可在經驗上被證偽的預測。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：探討存在本身與實在本質的本體論的
normal.explain: ontological (adj.)：探討存在本身與實在本質的本體論的。例句：The argument relies upon an unproven ontological assumption.（該項論證依賴於一個未經證實的本體論層面假定。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：形式有效性並不保證經驗真理。
normal.ans: VALIDITY DOES NOT GUARANTEE EMPIRICAL TRUTH
normal.speak: validity does not guarantee empirical truth
normal.explain: Validity does not guarantee empirical truth (phr.)：形式有效性並不保證經驗真理。。
normal.vocabId: R7:VALIDITY DOES NOT GUARANTEE EMPIRICAL TRUTH

normal.desc: 請唸出：經驗觀察本質上受理論制約。
normal.explain: Observation is conditioned by theory (phr.)：經驗觀察本質上受理論制約。。

normal.desc: 請拼出：依循邏輯規則從普遍前提推演的（D 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: DEDUCTIVE (adj.)：依循邏輯規則從普遍前提推演的。例句：Deductive reasoning moves from general principles to specific cases.（演繹推理遵循普遍原則推導至個別特殊案例。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：從多數個別經驗觀察歸納通則的（I 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: INDUCTIVE (adj.)：從多數個別經驗觀察歸納通則的。例句：Inductive generalization cannot provide mathematical certainty.（歸納法的概括通則無法提供數學層面的絕對必然性。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在邏輯上同義反覆而不增添新資訊的重言式（T 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: TAUTOLOGY (n.)：在邏輯上同義反覆而不增添新資訊的重言式。例句：The statement that all bachelors are unmarried is a tautology.（單身漢皆未婚之宣稱純屬不增添新知的同義反覆。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S O L E _ I S M (語法文理上之不合規範或禮儀失範)
normal.explain: SOLECISM (n.)：語法文理上之不合規範或禮儀失範。例句：The published paper contained an egregious logical solecism.（該篇發表論文包含了一處極其刺眼的邏輯失範之處。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A P _ R _ A (哲學思辨中陷入進退維谷的理路困境)
normal.explain: APORIA (n.)：哲學思辨中陷入進退維谷的理路困境。例句：Socrates led his interlocutors into philosophical aporia.（蘇格拉底引導其對話者陷入哲學思辨的困境死結。）

normal.desc: 填空題：V E R _ S I M _ L I _ U D E (極度逼真且看似真實存在的特質)
normal.explain: VERISIMILITUDE (n.)：極度逼真且看似真實存在的特質。例句：The historical novel possessed remarkable verisimilitude.（這部歷史小說具備令人驚嘆的逼真寫實歷史質感。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Diplomatic immunity shields accredited envoys from local criminal jurisdiction.
options: A. 駐在國政府有權任意查扣外國使館之外交郵袋。
B. 外交豁免權保護派駐使節免受駐在國刑事管轄。
C. 外交豁免僅適用於使館聘僱之當地行政人員。
D. 派駐使節在任何情況下皆必須在駐在國納稅。
normal.explain: diplomatic immunity 外交豁免，shields from criminal jurisdiction 免受刑事管轄。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The treaty was ratified by a two-thirds majority in the senate yesterday.
options: A. 條約因未達法定半數出席門檻而延後至明年表決。
B. 參議院要求在批准前先將條約提交公投表決。
C. 該條約昨日在參議院以三分之二的多數正式獲得批准。
D. 參議院全體議員一致表決否決了該項國際條約。
normal.explain: ratified by a two-thirds majority 三分之二多數批准條約。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Sanctions were imposed to curtail the proliferation of ballistic missiles.
options: A. 制裁措施促使彈道飛彈的國際貿易大幅成長。
B. 所有制裁在飛彈發射試驗開始前便已被全數撤銷。
C. 制裁僅限制該國農產品與民生紡織品的正常出口。
D. 國際社會實施制裁以遏止彈道飛彈技術的擴散。
normal.explain: curtail proliferation of missiles 遏制飛彈擴散。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Sovereign equality remains a foundational pillar of the modern interstate order.
options: A. 主權平等原則僅適用於經濟產值排名前十的大國。
B. 現代國際法已徹底廢除國家享有獨立主權的法律地位。
C. 主權平等依然是現代國家間國際秩序的根本基石。
D. 國際秩序的核心精神在於保障強權支配弱國的特權。
normal.explain: sovereign equality 主權平等，foundational pillar 根本基石。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The armistice halted active combat, but left the underlying territorial dispute unresolved.
options: A. 停戰協定的簽署標誌著兩國永久邊界問題徹底落幕。
B. 領土爭端的解決使得前線部隊無需再簽署停火協議。
C. 實質交火在停戰協定公布後迅速擴大至周邊鄰國。
D. 停戰協定終止了實質交火，但仍未解決潛在的領土爭端。
normal.explain: armistice halted combat 停戰止火，left dispute unresolved 留存爭端。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Economic interdependence reduces the likelihood of war, yet it does not eliminate systemic rivalry.
options: A. 經濟上的相互依存降低了戰爭機率，但並未消除體制性競爭。
B. 相互依存保證了各國之間永遠不可能爆發軍事對抗。
C. 體制性競爭迫使所有貿易夥伴在一夕之間徹底中斷貿易。
D. 經濟往來被證明是促發大規模地緣政治衝突的唯一根源。
normal.explain: reduces likelihood of war, yet does not eliminate rivalry 降低機率但不消弭競爭。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The declaration was aspirational in character, lacking the force of a binding covenant.
options: A. 該宣言自簽署日起即賦予各締約國嚴格的法定責任。
B. 宣示性文件在國際司法審判中享有超越成文法規之效力。
C. 各國元首拒絕簽署這份具備嚴格法律制裁條款的公約。
D. 該宣言本質上屬於宣示性的願景，欠缺具拘束力公約的強制力。
normal.explain: aspirational in character 願景宣示性質，lacking binding force 缺乏強制力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The alliance framework proved resilient because member states shared deep normative commitments.
options: A. 該同盟架構經受住了考驗，因成員國共享深厚的價值與規範承諾。
B. 同盟的穩定完全建立在成員國之間彼此相互猜忌的基礎上。
C. 共享的價值承諾在面對外部軍事威脅時被證明毫無助益。
D. 同盟在成立的第一年便因規範衝突而陷入全面癱瘓分裂。
normal.explain: normative commitments 價值規範承諾，resilient 同盟堅韌。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Deterrence depends upon credibility: a threat that is perceived as a bluff invites provocation.
options: A. 主動挑釁是維持防衛威懾長期可信度的唯一可行策略。
B. 威懾的成效取決於可信度：被視為虛張聲勢的威脅反而招致挑釁。
C. 只要軍事實力強大，威脅是否可信便對威懾效果毫無影響。
D. 虛張聲勢的外交恫嚇在歷史上始終被證明是最有效的防禦。
normal.explain: deterrence depends upon credibility 威懾依賴可信度，bluff invites provocation 虛張聲勢招致挑釁。

normal.desc: 【條約】The bilateral accord enters into force upon exchange of the instruments of ratification. What is the trigger for enforcement?
options: A. The public announcement by both heads of state.
B. The formal exchange of ratification instruments.
C. A unanimous resolution by the United Nations.
D. The signing of the initial draft treaty.
normal.explain: enters into force upon exchange of instruments of ratification 明文規定生效條件。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ambassador emphasized that strategic ambiguity was designed to deter unilateral changes to the status quo. What is the intended effect?
options: A. Eliminating all confidential diplomatic negotiations.
B. Guaranteeing an unconditional mutual defense alliance.
C. Discouraging either party from altering the situation alone.
D. Forcing an immediate military confrontation.
normal.explain: strategic ambiguity 戰略模糊性旨在 deter unilateral changes（遏阻單方面改變現狀）。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had the envoy ___ the ultimatum yesterday, hostilities would have erupted along the border.
options: A. deliver
B. delivering
C. was delivered
D. delivered
normal.explain: Had the envoy delivered ... would have erupted 為過去虛擬假設倒裝句型。

normal.desc: 【語用】The minister described the summit as constructive, while acknowledging that territorial disputes remained unresolved. What was the outcome?
options: A. Both nations agreed to abolish their shared borders.
B. All territorial claims were definitively abandoned.
C. Progress was made, though primary differences persist.
D. The summit was a total failure with no mutual dialogue.
normal.explain: 形容為 constructive 但 territorial disputes remain，進展與分歧並存。

normal.desc: 【推論】A nation accepts binding arbitration only on condition that the tribunal’s mandate excludes maritime boundary delimitation. What is excluded?
options: A. Commercial trade disputes involving state-owned vessels.
B. Historical claims to inland freshwater lakes.
C. Compensation claims filed by private citizens.
D. Decisions regarding the division of maritime borders.
normal.explain: mandate excludes maritime boundary delimitation 明文排除海洋邊界劃分。

normal.desc: 【戰略】The report warns that appeasement often emboldens revisionist powers rather than satisfying their territorial ambitions. What does appeasement do?
options: A. It encourages aggressive states to make further demands.
B. It establishes permanent peace through shared commerce.
C. It forces revisionist powers into economic bankruptcy.
D. It guarantees absolute adherence to international law.
normal.explain: emboldens revisionist powers 指姑息使修正主義擴張勢力更加肆無忌憚。

normal.desc: 【外交】The embassy granted temporary diplomatic asylum, citing customary humanitarian protections recognized across the continent. On what ground was it granted?
options: A. An explicit extradition treaty signed by both states.
B. A direct instruction issued by the local municipal police.
C. The applicant’s status as a registered commercial trader.
D. Continental customary norms regarding humanitarian refuge.
normal.explain: citing customary humanitarian protections 以習慣人道庇護常規為依據。

normal.desc: 【批判】The analyst observed that the sanction regime harmed the civilian population disproportionately while consolidating the ruling regime’s internal monopoly. What was the flaw?
options: A. It damaged ordinary citizens without weakening the leadership.
B. It proved completely ineffective at reducing international trade.
C. It caused neighboring states to declare war immediately.
D. It enriched foreign corporations at the expense of allies.
normal.explain: 制裁不成比例傷害平民，反倒鞏固了執政階層對資源的壟斷。

normal.desc: 【語用】The communiqué referred to a frank exchange of views, a standard diplomatic euphemism indicating sharp disagreement. What occurred?
options: A. Both parties refused to attend the scheduled banquet.
B. The participants clashed over contentious issues.
C. The leaders agreed unanimously on all agenda items.
D. The discussions were canceled due to translation errors.
normal.explain: frank exchange of views（坦率交換意見）在外交辭令中指重大分歧與激烈交鋒。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：國家對內享有最高管轄、對外獨立的主權
normal.explain: sovereignty (n.)：國家對內享有最高管轄、對外獨立的主權。例句：Respect for territorial sovereignty is fundamental to international law.（尊重領土主權是國際法不可動搖的根本原則。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：立法機關對國際條約的正式批准程序
normal.explain: ratification (n.)：立法機關對國際條約的正式批准程序。例句：The treaty requires parliamentary ratification before taking effect.（該條約需經國會正式批准方能具體生效。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：僅涉及雙方國家或當事人的雙邊的
normal.explain: bilateral (adj.)：僅涉及雙方國家或當事人的雙邊的。例句：The two presidents signed a landmark bilateral trade accord.（兩國元首簽署了一項具里程碑意義的雙邊貿易協議。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：在國際體系或區域中具支配地位的霸權
normal.explain: hegemony (n.)：在國際體系或區域中具支配地位的霸權。例句：Regional hegemony provoked balancing coalitions among neighbors.（區域霸權的擴張激發了周邊鄰國建立均勢同盟。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：外交是講求戰略性妥協的藝術。
normal.ans: DIPLOMACY IS THE ART OF STRATEGIC COMPROMISE
normal.speak: diplomacy is the art of strategic compromise
normal.explain: Diplomacy is the art of strategic compromise (phr.)：外交是講求戰略性妥協的藝術。。
normal.vocabId: R7:DIPLOMACY IS THE ART OF STRATEGIC COMPROMISE

normal.desc: 請唸出：享有主權同時意謂承擔國際責任。
normal.explain: Sovereignty entails international responsibility (phr.)：享有主權同時意謂承擔國際責任。。

normal.desc: 請拼出：國家間經正式談判達成的和平或合作協議（A 開頭，6 個字母）
normal.explain: ACCORD (n.)：國家間經正式談判達成的和平或合作協議。例句：The peace accord brought an end to three decades of civil strife.（和平協議為長達三十年的內戰衝突劃下了句點。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：代表政府執行特定外交任務的特使（E 開頭，5 個字母）
normal.explain: ENVOY (n.)：代表政府執行特定外交任務的特使。例句：A special presidential envoy was dispatched to broker the talks.（一位總統特別使節獲派遣前往調解雙邊會談。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：為達成共同地緣政治目標建立的同盟集團（C 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: COALITION (n.)：為達成共同地緣政治目標建立的同盟集團。例句：An international coalition launched maritime patrols in the strait.（一個國際同盟集團在海峽展開了聯合海上巡邏行動。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R O C L A _ A T I O N (官方正式向國際社會發布的重大公告宣言)
normal.explain: PROCLAMATION (n.)：官方正式向國際社會發布的重大公告宣言。例句：The president issued a proclamation regarding territorial waters.（總統就本國領海範圍正式發布了官方公告宣言。）

normal.desc: 填空題：H E G _ M O _ I C (在國際關係中展現霸權支配意圖與特質的)
normal.explain: HEGEMONIC (adj.)：在國際關係中展現霸權支配意圖與特質的。例句：The empire pursued hegemonic expansion across the continent.（該帝國在整座大陸上推行了帶有霸權色彩的擴張主義。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O _ R _ I _ E (訴諸武力威脅或實質制裁之強制性的)
normal.explain: COERCIVE (adj.)：訴諸武力威脅或實質制裁之強制性的。例句：Coercive diplomacy relies upon a credible threat of force.（強制性外交仰賴以具備可信度的武力威脅作為後盾。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Fiscal stimulus measures were deployed to avert an impending economic recession.
options: A. 政府決定全面終止對基礎建設的所有公共投資預算。
B. 中央銀行宣布將基準利率上調至歷史最高水平。
C. 當局推行財政刺激措施以防範迫在眉睫的經濟衰退。
D. 財政緊縮政策促成了國內經濟活動的大規模繁榮。
normal.explain: fiscal stimulus 財政刺激，avert recession 防範衰退。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The currency depreciated against the euro following the interest rate cut.
options: A. 降息措施使得該國貨幣匯率創下歷史最高升值紀錄。
B. 兩國央行達成協議將雙方匯率永久固定在等值水準。
C. 貨幣貶值促使該國中央銀行立即實施外匯管制作為。
D. 在調降基準利率之後，該國貨幣對歐元呈現顯著貶值。
normal.explain: depreciated against the euro 降息後對歐元貶值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Sovereign debt yields rose sharply amid concerns over fiscal sustainability.
options: A. 在對財政永續性的疑慮中，主權公債殖利率大幅攀升。
B. 投資人對主權財政的信心促使公債殖利率降至零點。
C. 政府宣布將在年底前提前全數清償所有到期公債。
D. 公債殖利率之變動與該國政府之財政赤字毫無關聯。
normal.explain: yields rose amid concerns over fiscal sustainability 財政疑慮推升殖利率。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The trade deficit narrowed as export volumes rebounded during the fourth quarter.
options: A. 進口總額的激增導致貿易逆差擴大至歷史新高水準。
B. 第四季出口完全停滯使得貿易帳呈現大幅度的盈餘。
C. 該國政府全面禁止所有進口商品的報關與市場銷售。
D. 隨著第四季出口總量強勁反彈，對外貿易逆差有所收窄。
normal.explain: trade deficit narrowed 貿易逆差收窄，exports rebounded 出口反彈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Inelastic demand implies that consumer purchases change very little when prices fluctuate.
options: A. 非彈性需求意味著當商品價格波動時，消費者購買量的變化極小。
B. 非彈性需求之商品價格若上漲，消費者需求便立即歸零。
C. 所有奢侈品在經濟學上皆被歸類為具備絕對非彈性需求。
D. 價格的大幅下跌會導致非彈性需求商品之銷量呈指數暴增。
normal.explain: inelastic demand 非彈性需求，purchases change very little 購買量變動極微。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The restructuring plan involved an equity swap that diluted existing shareholder value.
options: A. 股東大會一致投票否決了任何針對公司資產重組之建議。
B. 重組方案涉及債轉股置換，從而稀釋了既有股東的股權價值。
C. 債轉股方案使既有股東的持股比例在重組後大幅攀升。
D. 所有公司債務在未進行股權稀釋的情況下獲得全額現金清償。
normal.explain: equity swap 債轉股置換，diluted shareholder value 稀釋股東價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The subsidy was phased out gradually to prevent market distortion in the agricultural sector.
options: A. 該項補貼採取分階段逐步退場，以防範對農業部門造成市場扭曲。
B. 政府決定永久維持對農產品的高額直接價格補貼政策。
C. 補貼的立即取消被證明徹底解決了農產品生產過剩之危機。
D. 市場扭曲現象主要源自該國農民拒絕採用任何現代機械設備。
normal.explain: phased out gradually 逐步退場，prevent market distortion 防範市場扭曲。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The credit crunch emerged not from a lack of base money, but from an evaporation of interbank trust.
options: A. 信貸緊縮之出現證實中央銀行的最後貸款人職能完全無效。
B. 信貸緊縮之爆發非因基礎貨幣匱乏，而是源於銀行間拆借信任之蒸發。
C. 銀行間的深厚信任成功遏止了任何可能出現的信貸緊縮風暴。
D. 基礎貨幣的大量增發使得所有商業銀行主動放棄了風險審查。
normal.explain: credit crunch 信貸緊縮，evaporation of interbank trust 同業信任瓦解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Austerity policies dampened aggregate demand, entrenching economic stagnation rather than spurring recovery.
options: A. 總體需求的擴張被緊縮政策證明是引發高額失業之罪魁禍首。
B. 各界一致認定財政緊縮乃是擺脫流動性陷阱最為迅速之途徑。
C. 緊縮財政政策壓抑了總體需求，非但未促成復甦，反而加深了經濟停滯。
D. 緊縮政策透過大幅削減公共預算，奇蹟般促成了全體就業增長。
normal.explain: austerity dampened aggregate demand 緊縮壓抑總需求，entrenching stagnation 加深停滯。

normal.desc: 【金融】The central bank lowered the reserve requirement to inject liquidity into the commercial banking sector. What was the purpose?
options: A. Forcing commercial banks to close their international branches.
B. Mandating that all loans be repaid within twenty-four hours.
C. Increasing the supply of available funds for lending.
D. Decreasing the total money supply in the domestic economy.
normal.explain: lowered reserve requirement to inject liquidity 降準以注入流動性。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company faced insolvency after consecutive quarters of operational losses and debt defaults. What condition occurred?
options: A. A sudden surge in foreign investment capital.
B. The transition from private ownership to state control.
C. A record increase in quarterly corporate revenues.
D. The inability to meet financial debt obligations as they fall due.
normal.explain: insolvency 指無法償還到期債務之無力償債狀態。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had interest rates ___ raised earlier, the property bubble would not have expanded so dramatically.
options: A. been
B. were
C. was
D. being
normal.explain: Had interest rates been raised earlier 為與過去事實相反的倒裝條件句。

normal.desc: 【語用】The economist described the recovery as uneven, noting that service sectors lagged behind manufacturing. What was her evaluation?
options: A. The entire national economy had collapsed into a severe depression.
B. Manufacturing output had dropped to historical lows.
C. All commercial sectors expanded at an identical rate.
D. Growth was concentrated in specific industries rather than shared equally.
normal.explain: uneven recovery 不均衡復甦：製造業走強而服務業滯後。

normal.desc: 【推論】A country pegs its domestic currency to the US dollar, requiring foreign reserves to intervene whenever currency pressures arise. What must the central bank maintain?
options: A. Sufficient foreign currency reserves for market intervention.
B. A total ban on domestic consumer spending.
C. An exclusive reliance on gold bullion for all transactions.
D. A prohibition on foreign commercial investment.
normal.explain: pegs currency requiring foreign reserves to intervene 需維持充沛外匯儲備。

normal.desc: 【概念】The term negative externality refers to a cost imposed on an uninvolved third party as a consequence of economic transactions. What is an example?
options: A. A dividend payment distributed to corporate shareholders.
B. Environmental pollution caused by factory production.
C. A salary bonus awarded to a high-performing employee.
D. A discount offered to bulk purchasing consumers.
normal.explain: negative externality 負外部性：生產造成的未補償環境污染。

normal.desc: 【政策】The tariff applies exclusively to imported steel alloys, exempting raw iron ore and finished consumer machinery. What is exempt?
options: A. Unprocessed iron ore and finished machinery.
B. All steel products regardless of origin.
C. Imports originating from treaty partner nations.
D. Every category of mineral raw materials.
normal.explain: exempting raw iron ore and finished consumer machinery 明確豁免原礦與成品。

normal.desc: 【批判】The analyst argued that quantitative easing inflated asset prices, thereby exacerbating the wealth gap between capital owners and wage earners. What was the critique?
options: A. Interest rate adjustments eliminated all sovereign debt.
B. Monetary stimulus disproportionately enriched asset holders.
C. The central bank caused an immediate collapse of the banking system.
D. Wage earners experienced unprecedented purchasing power gains.
normal.explain: 量化寬鬆推升資產價格，不成比例圖利資產階級並擴大貧富差距。

normal.desc: 【語用】The finance ministry characterized the deficit reduction target as aspirational rather than statutory. What did this imply?
options: A. The deficit will be eliminated automatically by statute.
B. All public spending has been frozen indefinitely by court order.
C. The target serves as a goal rather than a binding legal duty.
D. The government is legally mandated to balance the budget this year.
normal.explain: aspirational rather than statutory 指目標屬願景期許，非法定強制義務。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：資產可迅速轉換為現金之流動性
normal.explain: liquidity (n.)：資產可迅速轉換為現金之流動性。例句：Central banks maintain market liquidity during banking panics.（中央銀行在銀行恐慌期間維持金融市場的流動性。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：貨幣對外匯率貶值或資產實質折舊
normal.explain: depreciation (n.)：貨幣對外匯率貶值或資產實質折舊。例句：Currency depreciation raised the cost of imported raw materials.（貨幣貶值推高了進口原材料的採購成本。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：具備足夠資產以償付到期長期債務之償債能力
normal.explain: solvency (n.)：具備足夠資產以償付到期長期債務之償債能力。例句：An independent stress test confirmed the commercial bank’s solvency.（獨立的壓力測試證實了該商業銀行具備償債能力。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：經濟交易對無關第三方造成之外部效應
normal.explain: externality (n.)：經濟交易對無關第三方造成之外部效應。例句：Carbon taxes aim to internalize the negative externality of emissions.（碳稅旨在將溫室氣體排放之負外部性內部化。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：流動性是銀行體系的命脈所在。
normal.ans: LIQUIDITY IS THE LIFEBLOOD OF BANKING
normal.speak: liquidity is the lifeblood of banking
normal.explain: Liquidity is the lifeblood of banking (phr.)：流動性是銀行體系的命脈所在。。
normal.vocabId: R7:LIQUIDITY IS THE LIFEBLOOD OF BANKING

normal.desc: 請唸出：償債能力優先於盲目的增長擴張。
normal.explain: Solvency precedes growth and expansion (phr.)：償債能力優先於盲目的增長擴張。。

normal.desc: 請拼出：財政收支或國際貿易結算之結餘順差（S 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: SURPLUS (n.)：財政收支或國際貿易結算之結餘順差。例句：The national budget recorded an unexpected fiscal surplus.（國家財政預算錄得了出人意料的年度財政盈餘。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：支出大於收入之財政或貿易赤字（D 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: DEFICIT (n.)：支出大於收入之財政或貿易赤字。例句：The government borrowed abroad to finance its widening deficit.（政府向境外舉債以因應其日益擴大的財政赤字。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：與國家貨幣發行流通及央行政策相關的（M 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: MONETARY (adj.)：與國家貨幣發行流通及央行政策相關的。例句：The monetary authority raised the policy rate by fifty basis points.（貨幣主管機關將基準政策利率上調了五十個基點。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N F L A T _ O N A R Y (容易引發物價持續普遍上漲之通膨性的)
normal.explain: INFLATIONARY (adj.)：容易引發物價持續普遍上漲之通膨性的。例句：The sudden supply shock triggered an inflationary spiral.（突發的供應衝擊引發了一場物價通膨螺旋。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E Q U _ L I B _ I U M (供給與需求達到相互平衡協調之均衡狀態)
normal.explain: EQUILIBRIUM (n.)：供給與需求達到相互平衡協調之均衡狀態。例句：Market forces move commodity prices toward long-run equilibrium.（市場機制促使大宗商品價格朝向長期均衡點移動。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A R _ I _ R _ G E (利用不同市場價格差異進行無風險買賣的套利)
normal.explain: ARBITRAGE (n.)：利用不同市場價格差異進行無風險買賣的套利。例句：High-frequency trading firms profit from microscopic price arbitrage.（高頻交易公司透過捕捉微小的價格差異進行套利獲利。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The protagonist undergoes a profound moral epiphany during the storm scene.
options: A. 主角在暴風雨中決定完全放棄對家庭的所有責任。
B. 該場景因缺乏戲劇張力而被多數評論家視為敗筆。
C. 暴風雨的描繪在整部戲劇中僅僅具有裝飾性的效果。
D. 主角在暴風雨場景中經歷了一場深刻的心靈頓悟。
normal.explain: moral epiphany 道德與精神層面的深刻頓悟。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Catharsis provides the audience with emotional purgation through pity and terror.
options: A. 悲劇的宣洩淨化透過引發憐憫與恐懼，撫平觀眾心靈。
B. 悲劇之目的在於促使觀眾對劇中反派產生強烈憎恨。
C. 情感淨化被亞里斯多德判定為戲劇創作中最致命的缺陷。
D. 觀眾在觀賞悲劇時被要求保持絕對冷酷的理性旁觀立場。
normal.explain: catharsis 宣洩淨化：through pity and terror。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The author employed apostrophe, directly addressing the absent muse of history.
options: A. 該修辭手法被批評為過於口語化而欠缺文學美感。
B. 作者運用了頓呼修辭法，直接向缺席的歷史繆思呼喚。
C. 頓呼修辭旨在向現場觀眾提供詳盡的背景歷史數據。
D. 作者在詩中完全摒除了任何對超自然存在的擬人想像。
normal.explain: apostrophe 頓呼修辭法：直接向缺席者或抽象事物呼喚。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The poet used enjambment to propel the reader forward across the stanza break.
options: A. 詩人運用跨行連續法，引導讀者視線不停頓地躍過節奏間隔。
B. 跨行法在古典英詩中被用來強迫讀者在每行結尾停頓數秒。
C. 詩節之間的斷裂使得全篇詩作喪失了所有的音律連貫性。
D. 該詩人因過度墨守傳統格律規範而遭受年輕批評家非議。
normal.explain: enjambment 跨行連續：propels reader forward。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The juxtaposition of sacred hymns with street slang highlighted cultural hybridity.
options: A. 並置手法的使用使得該小說的文化內涵變得極度單一扁平。
B. 將神聖讚美詩與市井俚語並置，突顯了文化的混雜交融性。
C. 神聖詩歌與街頭俚語在小說中被證明屬於完全相同的語域。
D. 作者試圖透過並置修辭法證明市井語言在文學中毫無價值。
normal.explain: juxtaposition 並置對比，highlighted hybridity 突顯混雜性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Metonymy substitutes an associated attribute for the entity itself, as in the crown for royalty.
options: A. 以王冠代指王權在修辭學分類上被歸類為直接的字面描寫。
B. 轉喻與隱喻在結構上的唯一差異在於是否使用明喻關聯詞。
C. 轉喻修辭以相關聯的屬性代指事物本身，例如以王冠代指王權。
D. 轉喻修辭要求所使用的比喻事物必須與本體在外形上完全相同。
normal.explain: metonymy 轉喻：substitutes associated attribute。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The narrator’s dry, laconic delivery heightened the underlying tragic absurdity.
options: A. 簡短洗鍊的語言風格使得該小說無法傳達任何深刻的人生哲理。
B. 敘事者冷峻、簡短洗鍊的語氣，反倒放大了潛在的悲劇荒謬感。
C. 繁複冗長的敘事語調成功化解了故事結尾的悲劇沉重感。
D. 敘事者的冷峻被多數讀者誤讀為對劇中人物命運的無動於衷。
normal.explain: laconic delivery 簡練語氣，heightened tragic absurdity 放大了悲劇荒謬。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Intertextuality suggests that no literary work exists in isolation from the literary archive.
options: A. 孤立創作在現代文論中被確立為衡量一部作品原創性的唯一標準。
B. 所有文學作品之間的指涉關係皆被證明屬於惡意的剽竊抄襲行為。
C. 互文性理論表明，沒有任何文學作品能孤立於龐大文學系譜之外。
D. 互文性主張偉大的作家完全不需要閱讀前人留下的任何著作。
normal.explain: intertextuality 互文性：no work in isolation from archive。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The dissolution of linear time reflects the character’s fragmented traumatic memory.
options: A. 線性時間敘事在現代心理小說中被證實最能呈現創傷體驗。
B. 角色之記憶創傷在小說結尾透過順序編年體敘事獲得完全療癒。
C. 時間的崩解被文學批評界一致視為作者缺乏編劇技巧之體現。
D. 線性時間的瓦解崩解，深刻反映了角色創傷記憶的支離破碎性。
normal.explain: dissolution of linear time 線性時間瓦解，reflects fragmented trauma。

normal.desc: 【文學】The novel employs an unreliable narrator whose personal vanity distorts the accounts of historical events. Why should the reader be cautious?
options: A. The narrator is physically unable to speak to other characters.
B. The story is written entirely in an extinct dead language.
C. The novel contains no actual characters or plot progression.
D. The narrator’s self-regard compromises the truth of the storytelling.
normal.explain: unreliable narrator（不可靠敘事者）因虛榮偏見扭曲敘事。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The playwright used dramatic irony, allowing the audience to know the impending catastrophe while the protagonist remained oblivious. What occurs?
options: A. The spectators possess critical information hidden from the character.
B. The protagonist deliberately plans his own downfall in secret.
C. The actors refuse to follow the written lines of the script.
D. The audience is forced to leave the theater before the climax.
normal.explain: dramatic irony（戲劇反諷）：觀眾知曉角色所不知之關鍵事實。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had the poet ___ the archaic sonnet structure, the emotional intimacy would have been lost.
options: A. no abandoned
B. not abandoned
C. abandoned not
D. not abandon
normal.explain: Had the poet not abandoned 否定虛擬假設倒裝句型。

normal.desc: 【語用】The critic described the prose as luminous yet disciplined, avoiding ornate sentimentalism. What was praised?
options: A. Clarity and emotional restraint in the author’s style.
B. An excessive reliance on florid nineteenth-century adjectives.
C. The complete avoidance of any punctuation in the text.
D. The author’s willingness to plagiarize classical folklore.
normal.explain: luminous yet disciplined 指風格清晰透徹且具備高度節制。

normal.desc: 【推論】The poet utilizes synesthesia, describing a musical chord as heavy, dark velvet. What sensory interaction is created?
options: A. Eliminating all sensory descriptions from the poetic verse.
B. Translating auditory sensation into tactile and visual imagery.
C. Denying that musical notes can be expressed on paper.
D. Proving that visual art is superior to instrumental music.
normal.explain: synesthesia（通感）：將聽覺轉化為觸覺與視覺意象。

normal.desc: 【主題】The recurring motif of the ticking pocket watch reinforces the protagonist’s dread of mortality. What does the motif signify?
options: A. The technical precision of eighteenth-century clockmaking.
B. A secret message encoded by political conspirators.
C. The relentless and irreversible passage of human time.
D. The character’s wealth and luxurious taste in jewelry.
normal.explain: motif（主題母題）：懷錶滴答象徵無法逆轉的死亡威脅與時間流逝。

normal.desc: 【詩學】Free verse abandons strict metrical patterns, yet it relies upon internal rhythm, line breaks, and assonance for musicality. What does it reject?
options: A. The expression of genuine personal emotional experiences.
B. Rigid traditional meters and mandatory rhyming schemes.
C. All forms of spoken human language in performance.
D. The use of metaphors and imaginative comparisons.
normal.explain: free verse（自由詩）揚棄嚴格格律與固定押韻，但保留內在節奏。

normal.desc: 【批判】The reviewer noted that the film relied on melodramatic spectacle, sacrificing psychological complexity for cheap emotional manipulation. What was the flaw?
options: A. The historical costumes failed to match the designated century.
B. The soundtrack was performed entirely without orchestral strings.
C. Sensational theatricality took precedence over nuanced characterization.
D. The dialogue was spoken too quietly to be understood by viewers.
normal.explain: 以通俗劇的感官煽情犧牲了人物心理的深刻複雜性。

normal.desc: 【語用】The author praised the translation for capturing the idiomatic resonance of the original without slavish literalism. What made the translation successful?
options: A. It translated only the first and last chapters of the epic.
B. It invented entirely new characters to replace foreign ones.
C. It eliminated all philosophical dialogues from the text.
D. It conveyed cultural nuances without word-for-word rigidity.
normal.explain: capturing idiomatic resonance without slavish literalism 傳達神韻而非死板直譯。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：透過具體情節寄託深層道德政治意涵的寓言
normal.explain: allegory (n.)：透過具體情節寄託深層道德政治意涵的寓言。例句：Orwell’s Animal Farm is a celebrated political allegory.（奧威爾的《動物農莊》是一部著名的政治寓言小說。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：在作品中間接引經據典或指涉歷史典故的暗引
normal.explain: allusion (n.)：在作品中間接引經據典或指涉歷史典故的暗引。例句：The poem contains frequent allusions to classical Greek mythology.（這首詩頻繁暗引了古希臘神話中的經典典故。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：與美學、審美感知及藝術品味相關的
normal.explain: aesthetic (adj.)：與美學、審美感知及藝術品味相關的。例句：The gallery exhibition was curated with refined aesthetic judgment.（美術館的特展是以優雅精鍊的美學鑑賞力策劃而成的。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：在戲劇或小說中居於核心地位的第一主角
normal.explain: protagonist (n.)：在戲劇或小說中居於核心地位的第一主角。例句：The novel follows the flawed protagonist through decades of exile.（小說記錄了這位性格有瑕疵的主角長達數十年的流亡生涯。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：隱喻揭示了潛藏於概念之間的深層聯繫。
normal.explain: Metaphor reveals hidden conceptual relations (phr.)：隱喻揭示了潛藏於概念之間的深層聯繫。。

normal.desc: 請唸出：藝術的形式與實質內容彼此緊密交織。
normal.ans: FORM AND SUBSTANCE ARE INTIMATELY INTERWOVEN
normal.speak: form and substance are intimately interwoven
normal.explain: Form and substance are intimately interwoven (phr.)：藝術的形式與實質內容彼此緊密交織。。
normal.vocabId: R7:FORM AND SUBSTANCE ARE INTIMATELY INTERWOVEN

normal.desc: 請拼出：為達到滑稽諷刺效果而刻意模仿特定風格的滑稽仿作（P 開頭，6 個字母）
normal.explain: PARODY (n.)：為達到滑稽諷刺效果而刻意模仿特定風格的滑稽仿作。例句：The theatrical revue featured a hilarious parody of opera.（那場舞台時事諷刺劇包含了對經典歌劇的滑稽搞笑仿作。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：相對於韻文詩歌之散文體語言表達（P 開頭，5 個字母）
normal.explain: PROSE (n.)：相對於韻文詩歌之散文體語言表達。例句：He wrote novels in simple, elegant, and unadorned prose.（他以簡潔、優雅且樸實無華的散文體撰寫長篇小說。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：語言聲音或音樂節奏所呈現之抑揚頓挫韻律（R 開頭，6 個字母）
normal.explain: RHYTHM (n.)：語言聲音或音樂節奏所呈現之抑揚頓挫韻律。例句：The natural rhythm of the dialogue mimicked everyday speech.（對白的自然節奏韻律逼真模仿了日常生活中的口語交談。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A E S T H _ T I C S (探討美之本質與藝術哲學的美學學門)
normal.explain: AESTHETICS (n.)：探討美之本質與藝術哲學的美學學門。例句：Kant’s critique established modern philosophical aesthetics.（康德的批判哲學奠定了現代哲學美學的理論基礎。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S O L _ L O _ U Y (戲劇中角色獨自在舞台上表達內心獨白的獨白戲)
normal.explain: SOLILOQUY (n.)：戲劇中角色獨自在舞台上表達內心獨白的獨白戲。例句：Hamlet’s famous soliloquy ponders the mystery of death.（哈姆雷特著名的獨白戲深刻思索了死亡的終極奧秘。）

normal.desc: 填空題：M E _ A _ H _ R (不使用比喻連接詞而將兩事物概念融合的隱喻)
normal.explain: METAPHOR (n.)：不使用比喻連接詞而將兩事物概念融合的隱喻。例句：The poet employed sea voyages as a metaphor for aging.（詩人將出海遠航作為人類生命衰老歷程的深刻隱喻。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Biodiversity loss diminishes the stability and productivity of natural ecosystems.
options: A. 生物多樣性的流失削弱了自然生態系統的穩定度與生產力。
B. 多樣性喪失使得生態系在面對疾病與乾旱時更具抵抗力。
C. 所有自然生態系在物種單一化之後皆能自發提升生物量。
D. 物種數量的多寡在現代生態科學中被證明與環境穩定無關。
normal.explain: biodiversity loss diminishes stability 生物多樣性流失削弱穩定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The treaty established a transnational ecological corridor for migrating herbivores.
options: A. 各國政府決定在走廊兩側興建高壓電網以防範動物穿越。
B. 該條約為遷徙性草食動物建立了一條跨越國界的生態走廊。
C. 條約全面禁止野生動物在任何跨國保護區邊界之間遷徙。
D. 生態走廊之設立導致沿途野生草食動物遭到大規模獵捕。
normal.explain: transnational ecological corridor 跨國生態走廊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Wetlands serve as natural filtration systems, cleansing agricultural runoff before it enters the sea.
options: A. 排乾濕地被證明能夠顯著改善沿海沿岸海域的水質狀況。
B. 濕地生態系在地球水循環體系中不具備任何調節過濾功能。
C. 濕地扮演天然過濾系統的角色，在農田逕流匯入大海前加以淨化。
D. 濕地會將所有農藥殘留與重金屬廢水直接排入鄰近海灣。
normal.explain: wetlands serve as filtration systems 濕地具過濾淨化功能。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The decline of insect pollinators threatens global agricultural yields and wild flora.
options: A. 該報告指出殺蟲劑的大量噴灑是保護野生蜂群的最佳手段。
B. 授粉昆蟲的數量驟降威脅著全球農業產量以及野生植物群落。
C. 授粉昆蟲的減少促使全球所有農作物的收成量達到歷史新高。
D. 野生植物群落完全不需要依賴任何昆蟲即可完成授粉繁衍。
normal.explain: pollinators decline threatens yields 授粉昆蟲銳減威脅產量。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Invasive species disrupt native food webs by outcompeting endemic species for finite resources.
options: A. 本土物種在遭遇強勢競爭時會自發放棄對食物與水源的需求。
B. 食物網的結構在任何外來捕食者入侵時皆能保持絕對恆定不變。
C. 外來入侵物種透過在有限資源中壓制本土特有種，擾亂了食物網。
D. 入侵物種的引入始終被證明能自然擴增本土特有種的族群數量。
normal.explain: invasive species disrupt food webs 外來種擾亂食物網。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The keystone species exerts an ecological influence disproportionate to its numerical abundance.
options: A. 關鍵物種在生態系統中的重要性完全取決於其個體體型的大小。
B. 數量稀少的物種在任何生態群落中皆被證明是無足輕重的存在。
C. 移除關鍵物種被證實能使群落內所有其他物種均勻蓬勃繁衍。
D. 關鍵物種所發揮的生態影響力，遠遠超越其族群在數量上的佔比。
normal.explain: keystone species 關鍵物種，disproportionate influence 影響力遠超數量比例。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Ecological succession is the predictable sequence of species replacement following disturbance.
options: A. 演替過程在演化生物學中被證明是完全混亂且毫無規律可循的。
B. 火山噴發後的裸露岩石表面永遠不可能萌發任何先驅植物生命。
C. 生態演替乃是生態系在遭受干擾後，物種替代演化的可預測序列。
D. 生態干擾發生後，原始森林植被會在數天之內完全原樣復原。
normal.explain: ecological succession 生態演替：predictable sequence of replacement。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The Anthropocene marks a geological epoch in which human activity dominates earth systems.
options: A. 人類世在地質學上被定義為人類科技完全臣服於自然法則的時代。
B. 地球系統在人類活動干預下依然保持著未受擾動的原始平衡。
C. 人類活動對大氣層與海洋化學結構的衝擊被判定為微不足道。
D. 人類世標誌著一個人類活動在各方面主導重塑地球系統的地質年代。
normal.explain: Anthropocene 人類世，human activity dominates earth systems 人類活動主導地球系統。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Rewilding seeks to restore self-regulating natural processes by removing human management.
options: A. 再野化策略旨在透過撤除人為干預，恢復自然生態系統的自我調節功能。
B. 再野化要求在所有自然保護區內引進大規模集約化的林業管理。
C. 自我調節功能在自然界中唯有依靠高強度的人工灌溉方能維持。
D. 撤除人為管理在任何生態復育專案中皆被證明必然導致物種滅絕。
normal.explain: rewilding 再野化，restore self-regulating processes 恢復自我調節。

normal.desc: 【生態】The reintroduction of apex predators triggered a trophic cascade, restoring riparian vegetation. What was the effect?
options: A. Restoration of streamside vegetation across the park.
B. The complete extinction of all native herbivore species.
C. A catastrophic decline in water quality across the valley.
D. The immediate conversion of forests into arid farmland.
normal.explain: trophic cascade（營養級聯效應）恢復了溪流植被（riparian vegetation）。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The scientist observed that habitat fragmentation prevents gene flow between isolated wildlife populations. What is the consequence?
options: A. A total cessation of plant photosynthesis across the zone.
B. Restricted genetic exchange leading to inbreeding risks.
C. An immediate doubling of the total wildlife population.
D. The spontaneous evolution of new bird species in days.
normal.explain: fragmentation 棲地破碎化導致 gene flow（基因流動）受阻。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had the coastal mangrove forest not ___ preserved, storm surges would have devastated the shoreline.
options: A. was
B. be
C. been
D. being
normal.explain: Had ... not been preserved 過去虛擬條件倒裝句型。

normal.desc: 【語用】The climatologist described the climate model’s projection as alarming yet technically reversible. What was the verdict?
options: A. The climate models were based on intentionally falsified data.
B. The outlook is serious, but corrective action can still alter it.
C. The planet will become completely uninhabitable tomorrow.
D. No action taken today can influence environmental outcomes.
normal.explain: alarming yet reversible 情況嚴峻但仍可逆轉。

normal.desc: 【推論】An ecosystem exhibits high ecological resilience when it absorbs severe environmental disturbances without shifting into an alternate degraded state. What characterizes resilience?
options: A. The rapid industrial harvesting of all native timber resources.
B. The permanent elimination of all seasonal temperature swings.
C. The capacity to endure shocks without undergoing structural collapse.
D. The total immunity of an ecosystem to all natural disasters.
normal.explain: ecological resilience（生態韌性）：承受衝擊而不陷入退化崩解。

normal.desc: 【概念】The term carrying capacity refers to the maximum population size of a species that an environment can sustain indefinitely. What does it establish?
options: A. The physical weight limit of an individual mammal.
B. The legal speed limit for vehicles in national parks.
C. The volume of water carried by a glacial river during spring.
D. An environmental threshold for sustainable population size.
normal.explain: carrying capacity（環境承載力）：長期可支撐的最大族群規模門檻。

normal.desc: 【政策】The decree restricts chemical runoff into freshwater streams, exempting certified organic smallholders who utilize biological compost. Who is exempt?
options: A. Chemical fertilizer manufacturers located beside riverbanks.
B. All commercial livestock operations within the municipality.
C. Organic smallholders applying natural biological compost.
D. Large industrial agribusinesses operating automated sprayers.
normal.explain: exempting certified organic smallholders 明確豁免認證有機小農。

normal.desc: 【批判】The essay argued that carbon offset schemes allow corporate emitters to purchase green credentials while deferring actual operational decarbonization. What is the critique?
options: A. Carbon offsets have permanently eradicated global emissions.
B. Industrial corporations should be forbidden from planting trees.
C. Green credentials have reduced corporate stock values to zero.
D. Offsets function as moral licenses that delay genuine emission cuts.
normal.explain: 碳抵換被批判為延宕實質營運減碳的道德護身符。

normal.desc: 【語用】The researcher qualified her findings, noting that while localized coral bleaching had ceased, the thermal threshold remained perilously elevated. What did she emphasize?
options: A. A temporary halt does not equal long-term ecological security.
B. Coral reefs have completely adapted to high temperatures.
C. Thermal measurements were inaccurate due to equipment flaws.
D. Bleaching is a healthy biological indicator of ocean vitality.
normal.explain: halted does not equal security 短暫停止白化不等於生態長期安全。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：特定生態系中生物物種的多樣性
normal.explain: biodiversity (n.)：特定生態系中生物物種的多樣性。例句：Tropical rainforests harbor unmatched terrestrial biodiversity.（熱帶雨林孕育著陸地上無可比擬的豐富生物多樣性。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：生物群落與其物理環境相互作用之生態系統
normal.explain: ecosystem (n.)：生物群落與其物理環境相互作用之生態系統。例句：Mangrove ecosystems protect coastal communities from erosion.（紅樹林生態系統保護沿海社群免受海潮侵蝕。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：土地土壤或生態環境品質之退化與劣化
normal.explain: degradation (n.)：土地土壤或生態環境品質之退化與劣化。例句：Soil degradation threatens agricultural productivity in arid regions.（土壤退化威脅著乾旱地區的農業糧食生產力。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：生態系統遭受衝擊後自我復原的恢復力
normal.explain: resilience (n.)：生態系統遭受衝擊後自我復原的恢復力。例句：Ecological resilience allows coral reefs to recover from storms.（生態恢復力使得珊瑚礁在遭遇風暴重創後能夠自我復元。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：生態系統仰賴錯綜複雜的微妙平衡。
normal.explain: Ecosystems depend upon intricate balance (phr.)：生態系統仰賴錯綜複雜的微妙平衡。。

normal.desc: 請唸出：人類的生存繁衍與生物多樣性休戚相關。
normal.ans: HUMAN SURVIVAL IS TIED TO BIODIVERSITY
normal.speak: human survival is tied to biodiversity
normal.explain: Human survival is tied to biodiversity (phr.)：人類的生存繁衍與生物多樣性休戚相關。。
normal.vocabId: R7:HUMAN SURVIVAL IS TIED TO BIODIVERSITY

normal.desc: 請拼出：特定野生動植物生存繁衍所需的自然棲息地（H 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: HABITAT (n.)：特定野生動植物生存繁衍所需的自然棲息地。例句：Deforestation destroyed the natural habitat of endangered primates.（森林砍伐摧毀了瀕危靈長類動物的天然生活棲息地。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：地球上所有生物生存活動所構成之生物圈（B 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: BIOSPHERE (n.)：地球上所有生物生存活動所構成之生物圈。例句：Human emissions have altered the chemical balance of the biosphere.（人類排放的溫室氣體改變了整座地球生物圈的化學平衡。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：僅生長繁衍於特定地理區域的特有物種的（E 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: ENDEMIC (adj.)：僅生長繁衍於特定地理區域的特有物種的。例句：The remote volcanic island is home to dozens of endemic orchids.（這座偏遠的火山島孕育了數十種獨一無二的特有蘭花。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E G R A _ A T I O N (土壤品質或森林生態環境之劣化與退化)
normal.explain: DEGRADATION (n.)：土壤品質或森林生態環境之劣化與退化。例句：Overuse of pesticides contributed to severe soil degradation.（殺蟲劑的過度濫用導致了嚴重的土壤品質退化。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S Y M _ I O _ I S (不同物種之間互相依存且互利的共生關係)
normal.explain: SYMBIOSIS (n.)：不同物種之間互相依存且互利的共生關係。例句：Corals and microalgae live in an obligate marine symbiosis.（珊瑚蟲與微藻之間維繫著一種彼此互利的海洋共生關係。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E S _ R T I _ I C A _ I O N (原本肥沃的土地轉變為不毛沙漠之荒漠化)
normal.explain: DESERTIFICATION (n.)：原本肥沃的土地轉變為不毛沙漠之荒漠化。例句：Reforestation barriers help to combat encroaching desertification.（人工造林屏障有助於抵禦不斷逼近的土地荒漠化危機。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: No sooner had the envoy arrived than the summit was adjourned. What happened?
options: A. The summit was prolonged indefinitely.
B. The summit ended immediately upon the envoy arrival.
C. The envoy arrived after the summit had concluded.
D. The envoy delayed the commencement of negotiations.
normal.explain: No sooner had... than... 表示使節一抵達，峰會就隨即休會。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is not economic scarcity but regulatory inertia that impedes regional growth. What impedes growth?
options: A. Foreign trade competition.
B. Unpredictable natural disasters.
C. Administrative inaction and regulatory inertia.
D. Absolute lack of financial resources.
normal.explain: It is... that... 強調句強調真正的阻礙是 regulatory inertia（監管怠惰）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: So contentious became the territorial dispute that bilateral mediation collapsed entirely. Why did mediation fail?
options: A. Because third party mediators refused to attend.
B. Because the summit was held in secret.
C. Because treaty documents were misplaced.
D. Because the territorial conflict grew exceptionally bitter.
normal.explain: So + adj + verb + subj 倒裝強調因果程度，說明爭端激烈導致調解破裂。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Only after protracted arbitration did the consortium agree to compensate the displaced communities. When was compensation agreed?
options: A. Without any third party involvement.
B. Immediately after the initial petition.
C. Following lengthy and exhaustive legal proceedings.
D. Before formal negotiations had commenced.
normal.explain: Only after protracted arbitration 倒裝強調是在漫長仲裁之後才達成協議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Should unforeseen anomalies arise automated safety protocols will override manual command. Under what condition will override occur?
options: A. When the operator issues a manual command.
B. After regular working hours expire.
C. If safety protocols fail to initialize.
D. If unexpected irregularities occur.
normal.explain: Should... arise 省略 if 倒裝，表示若出現非預期異常則自動覆蓋手動指令。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Had the administration acknowledged the logistical bottleneck earlier the shortage could have been mitigated. What actually occurred?
options: A. The administration delayed recognition and a severe shortage ensued.
B. The administration acted proactively to prevent supply disruptions.
C. Logistical bottlenecks were successfully resolved in advance.
D. The shortage was manufactured by speculative distributors.
normal.explain: Had... acknowledged 為過去虛擬倒裝，暗示實際上未及早承認瓶頸導致短缺。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Bitterly did the spokesperson lament the politicization of international humanitarian aid. What was the spokesperson attitude?
options: A. Pleased by the political alignment of relief efforts.
B. Indifferent to the geopolitical debate.
C. Optimistic about future diplomatic negotiations.
D. Deeply grieved by the political exploitation of aid.
normal.explain: Bitterly did... 倒裝強化發言人對於人道援助遭到政治化的沉痛譴責。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: In no way can the preliminary telemetry be construed as conclusive proof of subterranean water. What does telemetry provide?
options: A. Inconclusive and merely provisional indications.
B. Definitive evidence of deep aquifers.
C. Complete disproof of subterranean moisture.
D. Irrelevant noise without scientific value.
normal.explain: In no way can... 倒裝表示初步遙測絕不能被視為決定性證據。

normal.desc: 【文法】Seldom ___ such an unyielding consensus among rival political factions.
options: A. witnessed observers
B. had observers witnessed
C. observers witnessed
D. observers had witnessed
normal.explain: 否定副詞 Seldom 置於句首引導部分倒裝，助動詞 had 須置於主詞 observers 之前。

normal.desc: 【修辭】Not until the final audit was published ___ the full extent of the fiscal embezzlement.
options: A. had the board realized
B. realized the board
C. did the board realize
D. the board realized
normal.explain: Not until... 引導時間子句置於句首時，主要子句須採用倒裝語序 did the board realize。

normal.desc: 【強調】It was precisely her uncompromising integrity ___ preserved the institutional credibility of the council.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. what
D. that
normal.explain: It is/was... that... 分裂強調句，被強調部分為名詞片語 her uncompromising integrity。

normal.desc: 【篇章】Only by subjecting empirical hypotheses to rigorous refutation ___ ensure genuine scientific advancement.
options: A. researchers will
B. should researchers have
C. can researchers
D. researchers can
normal.explain: Only by + 介系詞片語置於句首時，主要子句須倒裝為情態助動詞 can + 主詞 researchers。

normal.desc: 【讓步】Much as the committee appreciated the delegate eloquence, they could not endorse the fiscal proposal. What was the committee stance?
options: A. They were swayed entirely by his moving delivery.
B. They rejected both the speech and the delegate.
C. They approved the funding due to his persuasiveness.
D. They valued his delivery but rejected the substance of the proposal.
normal.explain: Much as... 引導讓步從句表示「儘管非常欣賞…」，但主要子句仍否決了財政提案。

normal.desc: 【倒裝】Under no circumstances ___ confidential diplomatic correspondence be disclosed to unauthorized third parties.
options: A. may
B. should it
C. could have
D. might not
normal.explain: 否定介系詞片語 Under no circumstances 置於句首，情態動詞 may/should 須前置於主詞之前。

normal.desc: 【倒裝】Little ___ that the contractual caveat would eventually jeopardize their corporate sovereignty.
options: A. the executives anticipated
B. had anticipated the executives
C. the executives did anticipate
D. did the executives anticipate
normal.explain: 否定副詞 Little 置於句首表示「完全沒料到」，助動詞 did 須前置倒裝。

normal.desc: 【語用】Hardly had the ceasefire been ratified ___ skirmishes flared along the contested border.
options: A. when
B. than
C. as
D. while
normal.explain: Hardly... when... 固定句型，表示剛批准停火協議，邊境就爆發衝突。

normal.desc: 請唸出：極少見到；罕有目睹
normal.explain: seldom have we seen (phr.)：極少見到；罕有目睹。例句：Seldom have we seen such institutional resilience in the face of crisis.（在面對危機時，我們極少見到如此卓越的體制韌性。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：直到…才（倒裝連接片語）
normal.explain: not until (phr.)：直到…才（倒裝連接片語）。例句：Not until transparency is established will investor confidence be fully restored.（直到透明度建立之後，投資人信心才會徹底恢復。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：一…就…（倒裝時間關聯）
normal.explain: hardly had (phr.)：一…就…（倒裝時間關聯）。例句：Hardly had the treaty been signed when regional disputes reignited.（條約剛一簽署，區域爭端便隨之再度點燃。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：絕不；在任何情況下都不
normal.explain: under no circumstances (phr.)：絕不；在任何情況下都不。例句：Under no circumstances should safety regulations be compromised for expediency.（在任何情況下，都絕不能為了權宜之計而犧牲安全規範。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：唯有透過；只有藉由
normal.explain: only through (phr.)：唯有透過；只有藉由。例句：Only through collective endeavor can civil societies overcome structural inequality.（唯有透過集體努力，公民社會方能克服結構性不平等。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：調查所揭示的正是
normal.explain: what the inquiry showed (phr.)：調查所揭示的正是。例句：What the empirical inquiry illuminated was a profound cognitive divergence.（實證調查所揭示的，正是深刻的認知分歧。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：若董事會當時採取行動
normal.explain: had the board acted (phr.)：若董事會當時採取行動。例句：Had the board exercised due diligence the financial catastrophe could have been averted.（若董事會當時恪盡審慎義務，這場金融災難本可避免。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：如此錯綜複雜以至於
normal.explain: so intricate was (phr.)：如此錯綜複雜以至於。例句：So intricate was the statutory framework that few practitioners mastered its scope.（法規體系如此錯綜複雜，以致於極少有實務工作者能通曉其範疇。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：文法中將助動詞或動詞置於主詞之前的倒裝結構（I 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: INVERSION (n.)：文法中將助動詞或動詞置於主詞之前的倒裝結構。例句：Negative inversion lends a solemn and authoritative cadence to prose.（否定倒裝為文章賦予了莊重而權威的韻律。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：對政策文件或財務進行嚴密審查與仔細檢驗（S 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: SCRUTINY (n.)：對政策文件或財務進行嚴密審查與仔細檢驗。例句：Every clause in the diplomatic pact was subjected to multilateral scrutiny.（外交條約中的每一項條款都接受了多邊的嚴密審查。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：體制缺乏動力的怠惰遲滯或物理慣性（I 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: INERTIA (n.)：體制缺乏動力的怠惰遲滯或物理慣性。例句：Bureaucratic inertia often paralyzes reform efforts before they gain traction.（官僚體制的怠惰往往在改革發揮效用前使其陷入癱瘓。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：非法侵占或挪用公款與委託資金（E 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: EMBEZZLE (v.)：非法侵占或挪用公款與委託資金。例句：The comptroller conspired to embezzle sovereign reserve capital.（主計長密謀侵占國家外匯儲備資金。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：以嚴謹邏輯或反例駁斥證偽某種論點假說（R 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: REFUTATION (n.)：以嚴謹邏輯或反例駁斥證偽某種論點假說。例句：His treatise provided a definitive refutation of prevailing monetary dogmas.（他的論文對當時盛行的貨幣教條提供了決定性的駁斥證偽。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：會議法庭或官方協商宣布休會延期（A 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: ADJOURN (v.)：會議法庭或官方協商宣布休會延期。例句：The parliamentary speaker decided to adjourn the contentious debate.（國會議長決定將這場充滿爭議的辯論休會延期。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：縮減預算開支或限制特權規模（C 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: CURTAIL (v.)：縮減預算開支或限制特權規模。例句：Civil liberties were curtailed during the prolonged state of emergency.（在漫長的全國緊急狀態期間，公民自由受到了嚴格限制與縮減。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：小規模邊界交火短暫爭執或非正規衝突（S 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: SKIRMISH (n.)：小規模邊界交火短暫爭執或非正規衝突。例句：Border skirmishes threatened to undermine the tentative demilitarization treaty.（邊境的小規模衝突威脅到了初步非軍事化條約的落實。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N V E _ S I O N (文法中將動詞置於主詞前的倒裝結構)
normal.explain: INVERSION (n.)：文法中將動詞置於主詞前的倒裝結構。例句：Subject auxiliary inversion is obligatory following initial negative adverbials.（在句首否定副詞之後，主詞與助動詞倒裝是強制性的文法規則。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I _ E _ T _ A (體制遲滯不前的惰性現象)
normal.explain: INERTIA (n.)：體制遲滯不前的惰性現象。例句：Overcoming cognitive inertia requires exposure to disconfirming evidence.（克服認知惰性需要接觸否定既有觀點的客觀證據。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C _ V _ _ T (協議中的保留條款或警示)
normal.explain: CAVEAT (n.)：協議中的保留條款或警示。例句：The legal counsel added an explicit caveat regarding potential retroactive liabilities.（法律顧問增加了一項關於潛在追溯責任的明確保留條款。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E M B E _ Z L E (侵占或挪用公款財產)
normal.explain: EMBEZZLE (v.)：侵占或挪用公款財產。例句：Corrupt officials attempted to embezzle humanitarian relief shipments.（腐敗官員企圖侵占國際人道救援物資。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A _ J _ U _ N (正式休會或暫停審理)
normal.explain: ADJOURN (v.)：正式休會或暫停審理。例句：The tribunal will adjourn until tomorrow morning for final deliberation.（法庭將休會至明日清晨進行最後的閉門評議。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A _ O _ A _ Y (統計數據上的反常異數)
normal.explain: ANOMALY (n.)：統計數據上的反常異數。例句：Data cleansing algorithms filtered out statistical anomalies from the telemetry.（數據清洗演算法從遙測流中過濾掉了統計異常異數。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C U R _ A I L (削減限制或縮短規模)
normal.explain: CURTAIL (v.)：削減限制或縮短規模。例句：Sovereign governments moved to curtail speculative currency manipulation.（各國主權政府採取行動以限制並削減投機性匯率操縱。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The board stipulated that the CEO recuse himself from procurement voting. What was required?
options: A. The procurement vote was canceled indefinitely.
B. The board dissolved the procurement oversight committee.
C. The CEO must formally abstain from decisions on procurement.
D. The CEO was awarded full discretionary veto power.
normal.explain: stipulate that + 原形動詞 recuse，要求執行長利益迴避。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: If the diplomat had not negotiated the transit corridor last year supply lines would be paralyzed today. What is the situation?
options: A. Supply lines are currently completely paralyzed across the region.
B. The diplomat failed to negotiate the corridor last year.
C. Regional transit corridors were abandoned due to lack of funding.
D. Supply lines are operating because of last year successful transit treaty.
normal.explain: 錯綜條件句：去年談妥了走廊，因此今日補給線並未癱瘓。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is vital that international observers be granted unrestricted access to polling precincts. What is requested?
options: A. Unimpeded and full inspection rights at all voting stations.
B. Superficial observation through closed circuit cameras.
C. Observation limited exclusively to urban capital centers.
D. Post election access after all ballots have been destroyed.
normal.explain: vital that + 原形虛擬式 be granted，要求無限制進出投票所。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The treaty specifies that each signatory state dismantle its enrichment centrifuge within ninety days. What action is mandated?
options: A. The indefinite expansion of nuclear enrichment capacity.
B. The transfer of centrifuges to private commercial vendors.
C. A voluntary reduction of enrichment operations over a decade.
D. The physical deconstruction of centrifuge facilities within three months.
normal.explain: specify that + 原形動詞 dismantle，強制三個月內拆除離心機。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Be that as it may the geopolitical realities on the ground preclude immediate disarmament. What does the speaker convey?
options: A. Even acknowledging those arguments immediate disarmament remains impossible.
B. Disarmament will proceed immediately regardless of conditions.
C. Geopolitical conditions are completely conducive to peace.
D. The speaker unconditionally agrees with the opponent plan.
normal.explain: Be that as it may 為讓步虛擬結構，意為「即便如此，現實現狀仍無法立即裁軍」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The committee resolved that the dissenting memorandum be appended to the final conference communique. What was decided?
options: A. To hold a separate conference exclusively for dissenters.
B. To formally attach the disagreement note to the official communique.
C. To redact and censor all dissenting commentary completely.
D. To publish the dissent as an anonymous internet editorial.
normal.explain: resolve that + 原形虛擬式 be appended，決議將異議備忘錄附於公報之後。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is essential that scientific researchers preserve raw observational data prior to statistical modeling. Why?
options: A. To ensure absolute forensic integrity before computational processing.
B. To conceal experimental errors from independent peer reviewers.
C. To artificially inflate the perceived sample size of the study.
D. To comply with proprietary corporate marketing guidelines.
normal.explain: essential that + 原形動詞 preserve，強調建模前保留原始數據以確保鑑識嚴謹度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Had the archivist not indexed the microfilms in the 1970s modern historians would be unable to reconstruct deliberations. What helped?
options: A. The oral recollections of surviving delegates from the era.
B. The archivist diligent indexing half a century ago.
C. The public broadcast of the council secret audio recordings.
D. The recent discovery of unedited diplomatic memoirs.
normal.explain: 過去完成假設對應現在能力，歸功於檔案員當年的編目。

normal.desc: 【文法】It is imperative that the envoy ___ with full plenipotentiary authority during bilateral negotiations.
options: A. was invested
B. would be invested
C. be invested
D. is invested
normal.explain: imperative that 子句須使用原形動詞虛擬式 be invested（省略 should）。

normal.desc: 【虛擬】Had the civil engineers reinforced the levee system, the coastal basin ___ submerged today.
options: A. would have not been
B. is not
C. had not been
D. would not be
normal.explain: 過去完成式假設對應現在結果（錯綜條件句），主要子句使用 would not be。

normal.desc: 【原形虛擬】The oversight council demanded that every audit log ___ submitted without administrative redaction.
options: A. be
B. is
C. was
D. were
