normal.explain: demand that 引導賓語從句，謂語動詞使用原形虛擬式 be submitted。

normal.desc: 【篇章】If the treaty had not guaranteed tariff exemptions, domestic manufacturing ___ in severe distress at present.
options: A. would have been
B. had been
C. is
D. would be
normal.explain: 錯綜假設句：過去條件（had not guaranteed）造成現在影響（would be in distress at present）。

normal.desc: 【要求虛擬】The decree mandated that all municipal expenditure ___ subject to biweekly public disclosure.
options: A. be
B. was
C. should to be
D. being
normal.explain: mandate that 引導主語補語從句，動詞一律採用原形虛擬式 be。

normal.desc: 【條件】Were it not for international humanitarian corridors, thousands of stranded refugees ___ without potable water.
options: A. had remained
B. would remain
C. would have remained
D. remained
normal.explain: Were it not for... 表示「若非目前有…」，主要子句對應現在推測 would remain。

normal.desc: 【語用】If the central bank were to hike rates abruptly, capital markets ___ severe contraction.
options: A. would undergo
B. will undergo
C. underwent
D. had undergone
normal.explain: were to 表未來純粹假設，主要子句使用 would undergo。

normal.desc: 【修辭】Suffice it to ___ that diplomatic ambiguity often serves to avert immediate military escalation.
options: A. says
B. say
C. said
D. saying
normal.explain: Suffice it to say 為原形虛擬式成語，意為「只需說…就夠了；簡而言之」。

normal.desc: 請唸出：極為重要的是；勢在必行
normal.explain: it is imperative that (phr.)：極為重要的是；勢在必行。例句：It is imperative that the diplomatic delegation be granted absolute legal immunity.（極為重要的是，外交代表團必須獲得完全的司法豁免權。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：假使當時正常運作
normal.explain: had it functioned (phr.)：假使當時正常運作。例句：Had the early warning system functioned thousands of casualties would be averted today.（假使當時預警系統正常運作，今天成千上萬的傷亡本可得以避免。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：建議應予如何辦理
normal.explain: recommended that it be (phr.)：建議應予如何辦理。例句：The committee recommended that the draft constitution be submitted to a referendum.（委員會正式建議，應將憲法草案交付全民公投決定。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：只需說…就夠了；簡而言之
normal.explain: suffice it to say (phr.)：只需說…就夠了；簡而言之。例句：Suffice it to say that geopolitical ambiguity rarely resolves territorial discord.（簡而言之，地緣政治上的模稜兩可鮮少能夠真正解決領土紛爭。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：堅決要求應予如何處置
normal.explain: demanded that it be (phr.)：堅決要求應予如何處置。例句：The high court demanded that the clandestine surveillance program be dismantled immediately.（最高法院堅決要求，必須立即徹底拆除這項秘密監控計畫。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：若非因為現存之某因素
normal.explain: were it not for (phr.)：若非因為現存之某因素。例句：Were it not for sovereign credit guarantees the monetary union would be in insolvency.（若非因為國家主權信用擔保，貨幣聯盟今日早已陷入全面無力償債。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：明文規定各成員國應當
normal.explain: stipulated that each state (phr.)：明文規定各成員國應當。例句：The treaty required that each signatory state destroy its stockpile of chemical munitions.（條約嚴格規定，每個簽約國都必須銷毀其庫存的化學軍火。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：今日依然會處於凍結狀態
normal.explain: would still be frozen (phr.)：今日依然會處於凍結狀態。例句：If the arbitration had stalled last month financial liquidity would still be frozen today.（若仲裁上個月陷入停滯，金融體系的流動性今日依然會處於凍結狀態。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：擁有全權代表國家談判締約的全權特使（P 開頭，15 個字母）
normal.explain: PLENIPOTENTIARY (n.)：擁有全權代表國家談判締約的全權特使。例句：The sovereign dispatched a plenipotentiary to negotiate the armistice.（國家元首派遣了一位全權特使前往敵國商定停戰協定。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：因利益衝突自請迴避審理或表決（R 開頭，6 個字母）
normal.explain: RECUSE (v.)：因利益衝突自請迴避審理或表決。例句：Justice Miller deemed it ethical to recuse herself from the patent litigation.（米勒法官認為基於職業倫理應當自請迴避該專利侵權訴訟。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：沿河岸或海濱建造的防洪堤壩護堤（L 開頭，5 個字母）
normal.explain: LEVEE (n.)：沿河岸或海濱建造的防洪堤壩護堤。例句：The engineered levee withstood the catastrophic storm surge without breach.（人工加固的防洪大堤成功抵禦了災難性風暴潮的衝擊而未潰決。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：政府或國際高峰會正式發布的官方公報（C 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: COMMUNIQUE (n.)：政府或國際高峰會正式發布的官方公報。例句：The G7 released a joint communique condemning currency manipulation.（七大工業國集團發布了聯合官方公報，對匯率操縱行為予以強烈譴責。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在合約法規中明文規定具體條件（S 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: STIPULATE (v.)：在合約法規中明文規定具體條件。例句：The contract stipulates that intellectual properties remain proprietary.（商業合約中明文約定，所有研發產出的智慧財產權均屬專有所有。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在法庭宣誓具結後故意作假證之罪行（P 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: PERJURY (n.)：在法庭宣誓具結後故意作假證之罪行。例句：The defense witness was indicted on two counts of aggravated perjury.（被告方證人因涉嫌兩項情節嚴重的偽證罪而遭到檢方正式起訴。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：因保密對官方文件部分內容進行塗黑遮蔽（R 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: REDACTION (n.)：因保密對官方文件部分內容進行塗黑遮蔽。例句：The intelligence report was released with extensive redactions across operational pages.（情報公開報告發布時，對涉及行動細節的頁面進行了廣泛的遮蔽修訂。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：符合衛生標準可安全飲用的水質（P 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: POTABLE (adj.)：符合衛生標準可安全飲用的水質。例句：Desalination units supplied potable water to remote desert encampments.（海水淡化裝置為偏遠的沙漠營地提供了源源不絕的潔淨飲用水。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P L E N I P O _ E N T I A R Y (具備全權代表國家的)
normal.explain: PLENIPOTENTIARY (adj.)：具備全權代表國家的。例句：The ambassador arrived with plenipotentiary credentials to ratify the treaty.（大使攜帶全權全權證書抵達首都，以正式批准雙邊條約。）

normal.desc: 填空題：L _ _ _ E (防洪護堤基礎設施)
normal.explain: LEVEE (n.)：防洪護堤基礎設施。例句：Federal subsidies funded the reinforcement of the Mississippi levee network.（聯邦專項補貼為密西西比防洪堤壩網絡的全面加固提供了充足資金。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D I _ M _ N _ L E (逐步解散拆除組織架構)
normal.explain: DISMANTLE (v.)：逐步解散拆除組織架構。例句：The administration pledged to dismantle state monopolies across energy markets.（政府鄭重承諾將逐步拆除能源公用事業市場中的國家壟斷體制。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O M M U _ I Q U E (首腦會議之最終公報)
normal.explain: COMMUNIQUE (n.)：首腦會議之最終公報。例句：The bilateral communique affirmed mutual respect for territorial borders.（雙邊高峰會發表的最終公報，重申了對彼此領土邊界完整性的尊重。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P _ R _ U _ Y (具結偽證刑事責任)
normal.explain: PERJURY (n.)：具結偽證刑事責任。例句：Falsifying tax filings under oath constitutes a prosecutable act of perjury.（在具結宣誓下偽造報稅申報表，構成可被依法提起刑事公訴的偽證罪。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C E _ T R _ F _ G E (化學同位素分離設備)
normal.explain: CENTRIFUGE (n.)：化學同位素分離設備。例句：Advanced carbon composite centrifuge rotors increased isotope separation efficiency.（先進碳纖維複合材料離心機轉子，大幅提高了同位素的分離產率。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E D A _ T I O N (涉密文本遮蔽與編輯)
normal.explain: REDACTION (n.)：涉密文本遮蔽與編輯。例句：Heavy judicial redaction obscured the identities of undercover whistleblowers.（嚴密的司法塗黑遮蔽程序，有效隱蔽了深層臥底揭弊者的真實身分。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The economic statistics bear out the thesis that fiscal stimulus accelerates infrastructural renewal. What do they do?
options: A. They thoroughly disprove and dismantle the initial hypothesis.
B. They indicate that stimulus funds were entirely squandered.
C. They show no statistical correlation whatsoever.
D. They substantiate and confirm the validity of the thesis.
normal.explain: bear out 表示「證實、印證」。統計數據印證了財政刺激促進基建更新的論點。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The foreign minister urged negotiating parties not to let the perfect be the enemy of the good. What is the counsel?
options: A. Accept a pragmatic and viable compromise rather than holding out for unachievable perfection.
B. Refuse any treaty that contains minor imperfections.
C. Prolong the conflict until absolute victory is attained.
D. Abandon all diplomatic endeavors and resort to arbitration.
normal.explain: not let the perfect be the enemy of the good 勸告勿因追求完美而放棄切實可行之妥協。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The sovereign wealth fund decided to pull the plug on the unprofitable subsea pipeline venture. What action was taken?
options: A. They expanded operations into adjacent maritime territories.
B. They terminated and discontinued financial support for the venture.
C. They injected additional emergency capital into the pipeline.
D. They nationalized the corporate operating consortium.
normal.explain: pull the plug on 表示「終止注資、叫停中止項目」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The corporate merger had been in the pipeline for nearly eighteen months before filing. How long was it planned?
options: A. It had been actively prepared and under development for a year and a half.
B. It was spontaneously conceived within twenty four hours.
C. It was stalled due to total lack of regulatory interest.
D. It was officially rejected eighteen months ago.
normal.explain: in the pipeline 表示「正在籌備醞釀之中」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The delegate impassioned speech struck at the very root of institutional inequality. What did the speech target?
options: A. Unrelated foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
B. The fundamental foundational origin of the systemic problem.
C. Superficial administrative symptoms on the periphery.
D. The personal dietary habits of committee delegates.
normal.explain: strike at the root of 意為「直擊根本、正中要害」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The whistleblower decided to bite the bullet and submit the forensic dossier to prosecutors. What did they do?
options: A. Destroyed the documents to protect corporate executives.
B. Sold the confidential records to commercial tabloid outlets.
C. Confronted an agonizing decision and acted with grim determination.
D. Fled the jurisdiction to avoid personal legal liability.
normal.explain: bite the bullet 意為「咬緊牙關、硬著頭皮採取艱難行動」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The regional central bank has bent over backward to accommodate the liquidity needs of lenders. What did the bank do?
options: A. Liquidated its reserves to purchase foreign sovereign debt.
B. Exerted extraordinary and exhaustive efforts to assist local lenders.
C. Imposed draconian austerity penalties on regional banks.
D. Refused all requests for emergency credit facilities.
normal.explain: bend over backward 表示「竭盡全力、不遺餘力地遷就協助」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The proposed maritime border treaty proved to be a bone of contention throughout talks. What was the treaty?
options: A. A completely trivial matter requiring no debate.
B. A secret protocol signed prior to the formal summit.
C. A primary and persistent source of bitter dispute between factions.
D. A universally applauded consensus document.
normal.explain: bone of contention 意為「爭論的焦點、爭端根源」。

normal.desc: 【搭配】The ambassador took profound ___ at the foreign minister condescending insinuations.
options: A. offensement
B. agitation
C. disdainment
D. umbrage
normal.explain: take umbrage at 為高級書面搭配，意為「對…感到憤懣不悅、被冒犯」。

normal.desc: 【片語】The architect magnificent cathedral bears eloquent ___ to the technological genius of the era.
options: A. testament
B. testimony
C. protest
D. tribute
normal.explain: bear testament to 為固定搭配，意為「有力地證明…、是…的雄辯見證」。

normal.desc: 【成語】The new statutory regulations run entirely ___ to the principles of free and unrestricted commerce.
options: A. contrarywise
B. counter
C. opposite
D. backward
normal.explain: run counter to 表示「與…背道而馳、相抵觸」。

normal.desc: 【篇章】During the parliamentary inquiry, the defense counsel cast severe ___ on the credibility of the whistleblower.
options: A. aspersions
B. criticisms
C. doubts
D. invectives
normal.explain: cast aspersions on 為正式搭配，意為「惡意誹謗、詆毀…的名譽與可信度」。

normal.desc: 【片語】After decades of historical denial, the nation is finally coming to ___ with its colonial transgressions.
options: A. conditions
B. terms
C. words
D. agreements
normal.explain: come to terms with 表示「正視、妥協並逐漸接受痛苦現實」。

normal.desc: 【搭配】For nearly half a century, the authoritarian dynasty held absolute ___ over the peninsula commerce.
options: A. rule
B. controlment
C. sway
D. power
normal.explain: hold sway over 為高級搭配，意為「對…擁有絕對主導統治地位」。

normal.desc: 【語境】When cross-examined about the secret offshore bank accounts, the witness drew a complete ___.
options: A. gap
B. blank
C. void
D. space
normal.explain: draw a blank 為慣用語，意為「腦中一片空白、毫無頭緒或無法記起」。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The prime minister preemptive concession took the ___ out of the opposition campaign sails.
options: A. steam
B. breeze
C. wind
D. air
normal.explain: take the wind out of someone sails 表示「先發制人消除對手銳氣、挫其銳氣」。

normal.desc: 請唸出：作為雄辯之證明；有力見證
normal.explain: bear eloquent testament (phr.)：作為雄辯之證明；有力見證。例句：The ancient manuscripts bear eloquent testament to an advanced classical cosmology.（這批珍貴的古代泥金手稿，成為古典時代先進宇宙論體系的雄辯明證。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：感到極為不快；深感冒犯
normal.explain: took grave umbrage (phr.)：感到極為不快；深感冒犯。例句：The ambassador took grave umbrage at the condescending tone of the ultimatum.（特命全權公使對最後通牒中所流露出的居高臨下輕蔑語氣深感被冒犯。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：完全與…背道而馳；抵觸
normal.explain: run entirely counter to (phr.)：完全與…背道而馳；抵觸。例句：Protectionist trade measures run entirely counter to multilateral commercial agreements.（各國相繼出台的貿易保護主義壁壘，與多邊自由貿易協定的基本精神徹底背道而馳。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：逐漸接受妥協正視現實
normal.explain: come to terms with (phr.)：逐漸接受妥協正視現實。例句：A democratic society must come to terms with the dark chapters of its past.（一個健全成熟的民主社會，必須學會正視並深刻反省其歷史記憶中的黑暗篇章。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：掌握無可爭議之統治權柄
normal.explain: held undisputed sway (phr.)：掌握無可爭議之統治權柄。例句：The charismatic philosopher held undisputed sway over intellectual circles for decades.（這位魅力非凡的思想導師，整整數十年在當代學術知識界掌握著無可爭議的崇高地位。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：僅做口頭敷衍；口惠不實
normal.explain: pay mere lip service (phr.)：僅做口頭敷衍；口惠不實。例句：Global summits must not pay mere lip service to the imperative of climate resilience.（全球氣候高峰會絕不可僅對構建生態韌性的迫切任務進行口惠而實不至的表面敷衍。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：提出實質客觀證據加以證實
normal.explain: substantiate the claim (phr.)：提出實質客觀證據加以證實。例句：Empirical data from gravitational observatories substantiate the theoretical model.（來自全球重力波天文台的實時實測數據，徹底證實了愛因斯坦理論模型的正確性。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：竭盡全力；極致遷就迎合
normal.explain: bent over backward (phr.)：竭盡全力；極致遷就迎合。例句：The municipal council bent over backward to facilitate equitable urban housing.（市政協商委員會不遺餘力地協調各方，竭盡所能推動公平可負擔的都市安居政策。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：因受到輕視或冒犯而產生的憤懣不悅（U 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: UMBRAGE (n.)：因受到輕視或冒犯而產生的憤懣不悅。例句：The foreign secretary took umbrage at being excluded from the communique draft.（外交大臣因被排除在重要官方聯合公報的起草委員會之外而深感憤懣不快。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：具體證明某事實或價值的雄辯明證（T 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: TESTAMENT (n.)：具體證明某事實或價值的雄辯明證。例句：The enduring stone aqueducts are a testament to Roman civil engineering.（屹立兩千年的巍峨石造高架引水渠，是古羅馬土木工程卓越水準的永恆歷史明證。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：對他人品格或誠信的中傷誹謗侮辱（A 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: ASPERSION (n.)：對他人品格或誠信的中傷誹謗侮辱。例句：He cast harsh aspersions upon the professional motives of his scientific rival.（他在學術期刊社論中發表言論，惡毒誹謗其學術競爭對手的專業研究動機。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：虛偽狡黠的假裝誠懇實則心懷鬼胎（D 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: DISINGENUOUS (adj.)：虛偽狡黠的假裝誠懇實則心懷鬼胎。例句：The spokesperson offered a disingenuous defense of the offshore transactions.（發言人對該集團一系列高度涉嫌洗錢的離岸空殼交易，作出了虛偽狡黠的辯解。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：為他人提供便利遷就或適應需求（A 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: ACCOMMODATE (v.)：為他人提供便利遷就或適應需求。例句：Central banks adjusted collateral requirements to accommodate stressed lenders.（各國央行緊急放寬了合格抵押品認定標準，以全面遷就並紓解受困商業銀行的資金鏈。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：先發制人的搶先防患未然的戰術（P 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: PREEMPTIVE (adj.)：先發制人的搶先防患未然的戰術。例句：The military launched a preemptive strike against subterranean silo complexes.（聯合部隊對敵方的深層地下飛彈發射井基地實施了果斷的先發制人精確打擊。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：跨國企業銀行為大項目組成的聯合財團（C 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: CONSORTIUM (n.)：跨國企業銀行為大項目組成的聯合財團。例句：A multinational consortium was assembled to construct the deep sea cable.（由全球八大多國通信巨頭合組的聯合財團正式成立，負責鋪設這條越洋海底光纜。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：法律制裁或刑罰條款極其嚴酷苛刻（D 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: DRACONIAN (adj.)：法律制裁或刑罰條款極其嚴酷苛刻。例句：The governor enacted draconian curfews to suppress political demonstrations.（地方總督頒布了極其嚴苛的宵禁禁令與鐵腕管制措施，以徹底鎮壓民間抗議浪潮。）

normal.desc: 填空題：U M B _ A G E (因受冒犯而引發的不快情緒)
normal.explain: UMBRAGE (n.)：因受冒犯而引發的不快情緒。例句：Minor diplomatic snubs caused the envoy to take umbrage during reception.（外事接待禮儀中的微小冷落瑕疵，便足以讓極端注重體面的使節深感受辱與不快。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A S _ E _ S _ O N (缺乏證據之惡意誹謗抹黑)
normal.explain: ASPERSION (n.)：缺乏證據之惡意誹謗抹黑。例句：Defamation laws penalize parties who cast baseless aspersions on magistrates.（國家誹謗法對任何膽敢在沒有法庭證據下惡意詆毀治安法官聲譽者施以嚴懲。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S U B _ T A _ T I _ T E (以嚴謹鑑識手段證實假說)
normal.explain: SUBSTANTIATE (v.)：以嚴謹鑑識手段證實假說。例句：Forensic isotope ratios substantiate the provenance of the meteorite fragment.（嚴密的同位素光譜鑑識比對，確鑿無疑地證實了這塊極地隕石殘片源自火星地殼。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D I S I N G _ N U O U S (虛偽隱瞞實情的陳述態度)
normal.explain: DISINGENUOUS (adj.)：虛偽隱瞞實情的陳述態度。例句：Dismissing documented global warming as unproven speculation is disingenuous.（將早經國際同行確證的全球暖化科學事實貶低為毫無根據的猜想，是極其虛偽的。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R _ E M _ T _ V E (搶先一步實施的先手防衛)
normal.explain: PREEMPTIVE (adj.)：搶先一步實施的先手防衛。例句：The central bank announced a preemptive liquidity injection before holidays.（中央銀行在漫長國定長假休市前夕，主動宣佈實施預防性的先發制人流動性注入。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E X _ C E _ B _ T E (推波助瀾使衝突更不可收拾)
normal.explain: EXACERBATE (v.)：推波助瀾使衝突更不可收拾。例句：Escalating tariff retaliations threaten to exacerbate the global recession.（全球兩大貿易陣營相互升級的報復性懲罰關稅，隨時可能使全球經濟衰退雪上加霜。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O N S O _ T I U M (聯合開採與建設的跨國辛迪加)
normal.explain: CONSORTIUM (n.)：聯合開採與建設的跨國辛迪加。例句：The engineering consortium completed the transcontinental alpine tunnel.（這家跨國工程聯合財團歷時十載，終於鑿通了穿越整座阿爾卑斯山脈的戰略鐵路隧道。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Epistemological skepticism questions whether sensory perception can yield objective truth. What is under scrutiny?
options: A. The epistemic reliability and veracity of human senses.
B. The mathematical validity of geometric proofs.
C. The historical authenticity of ancient coins.
D. The mechanical durability of optical lenses.
normal.explain: 認識論懷疑論（Epistemological skepticism）質疑人類感官知覺能否獲取客觀真理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Thomas Kuhn posited that periods of normal science are punctuated by crises. What follows a crisis?
options: A. A complete consensus across all global religious bodies.
B. The collapse of prevailing models and emergence of a new paradigm.
C. The permanent termination of all scientific publications.
D. An unquestioned return to primitive mythological worldviews.
normal.explain: 庫恩認為常規科學時期會被革命性危機打斷，進而促使新典範誕生。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Cognitive dissonance denotes psychological discomfort experienced from holding contradictory beliefs. How is it relieved?
options: A. By ignoring physical sustenance and biological needs.
B. Through prolonged isolation in sensory deprivation chambers.
C. By rationalizing behavior or modifying one of the conflicting beliefs.
D. By immediately increasing the cognitive contradiction.
normal.explain: 認知失調（Cognitive dissonance）描述持有矛盾信念的不適感，通常透過合理化或調整信念緩解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: In phenomenology Edmund Husserl advocated the bracketing of assumptions. What does it entail?
options: A. Rejecting logical reasoning in favor of emotional impulse.
B. Suspending metaphysical presuppositions about external reality.
C. Endorsing empirical materialism without critique.
D. Memorizing classical theological catechisms.
normal.explain: 現象學的「懸置（bracketing）」指暫停對外在世界的預設判斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Heuristic shortcuts facilitate rapid decision making but introduce cognitive distortions. What are heuristics?
options: A. Exhaustive computational simulations of complex systems.
B. Unconscious physical muscle contractions.
C. Mental rules of thumb that streamline cognitive processing.
D. Rigorous formal mathematical proof algorithms.
normal.explain: 捷思法（Heuristics）是加速決策的思維法則，但易誘發系統性認知偏差。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Determinism argues that every event is necessitated by antecedent states and laws of nature. What does it challenge?
options: A. The mathematical validity of the law of gravity.
B. The possibility of technological engineering.
C. The biological reality of genetic inheritance.
D. The traditional concept of absolute unconditioned free will.
normal.explain: 決定論（Determinism）主張一切事件皆由前置狀態所必然決定，挑戰絕對自由意志。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The Duhem Quine thesis asserts that no scientific hypothesis can be tested in isolation. Why?
options: A. Because scientists are inherently biased toward funding agencies.
B. Because natural laws change unpredictably during laboratory tests.
C. Because testing always relies on an auxiliary web of background assumptions.
D. Because scientific apparatus is fundamentally defective and unreliable.
normal.explain: 杜恆奎因命題（Duhem Quine thesis）論證檢驗假說時必然依賴整體輔助假設網。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Epistemic humility demands that researchers acknowledge the provisional nature of conclusions. What does it foster?
options: A. An arrogant insistence on the infallibility of personal theories.
B. A cynical rejection of all empirical inquiry and data.
C. A blind deference to ancient ecclesiastic authority.
D. An open minded willingness to revise views in light of superior evidence.
normal.explain: 認知謙遜（Epistemic humility）促使研究者承認結論的暫定性並樂於依新證據修正。

normal.desc: 【認識論】Empirical verificationism asserts that a proposition is cognitively meaningful only if it is testable. What is the criterion?
options: A. The capacity of an assertion to be verified through observable sensory experience.
B. Its strict adherence to classical theological or metaphysical dogma.
C. The subjective emotional resonance it produces in listeners.
D. Its formal mathematical elegance regardless of tangible reality.
normal.explain: 經驗證實主義（Empirical verificationism）主張命題的認知意義在於其能否經由觀察經驗檢驗。

normal.desc: 【科學哲學】According to Karl Popper, what demarcates genuine science from pseudoscience?
options: A. The complete absence of theoretical speculation in research.
B. The principle of falsifiability rather than verification.
C. The unanimous consensus among contemporary academic institutions.
D. The absolute impossibility of formulating counterarguments.
normal.explain: 波普爾的科學哲學主張「可證偽性（falsifiability）」是區分科學與偽科學的分水嶺。

normal.desc: 【認知科學】Confirmation bias compels individuals to search for, interpret, and recall information in a biased manner. What does it cause?
options: A. An immediate willingness to abandon settled opinions upon dispute.
B. Random and arbitrary memory lapses during stressful examinations.
C. Selective attention and distorted interpretation favoring prior beliefs.
D. Objective and exhaustive evaluation of contradictory evidence.
normal.explain: 確認偏誤（Confirmation bias）使人傾向選擇性搜尋並詮釋符合既有信念的資訊。

normal.desc: 【邏輯】An ad hominem fallacy occurs when an arguer attacks the opponent personal character rather than:
options: A. consulting public opinion polls on the matter.
B. evaluating the logical substance and evidence of their argument.
C. checking the spelling and grammatical structure of their prose.
D. agreeing with the opponent premises unconditionally.
normal.explain: 人身攻擊謬誤（ad hominem）是指攻擊辯手個人特質而非評估其論證實質。

normal.desc: 【認識論】Epistemic closure describes a condition wherein a community rejects all external evidence. What is the consequence?
options: A. Universal tolerance toward foreign philosophical traditions.
B. The complete abandonment of all ideological convictions.
C. Intellectual insularity and total resistance to corrective facts.
D. Rapid adaptation and welcoming of dissenting empirical findings.
normal.explain: 認知閉環（Epistemic closure）導致群體思想封閉，全面排斥與其信念相左的外部證據。

normal.desc: 【篇章】Occam razor dictates that when presented with competing hypotheses, scientists should select the one that:
options: A. requires the largest quantity of theoretical entities.
B. is supported by the most prestigious political authorities.
C. relies most heavily on poetic and symbolic imagery.
D. makes the fewest explanatory assumptions.
normal.explain: 奧坎剃刀（Occam razor）主張在相容的解釋假說中，應優先選擇假設前提最少者。

normal.desc: 【科學】A paradigm shift occurs not merely through incremental data accumulation, but through:
options: A. the unconditional revival of discarded ancient doctrines.
B. administrative mandates issued by government ministries.
C. a radical fundamental restructuring of core theoretical frameworks.
D. minor typographical revisions in academic textbooks.
normal.explain: 典範轉移（Paradigm shift）指核心理論框架的根本性重構，而非單純數據累積。

normal.desc: 【倫理】The trolley problem is a classic thought experiment designed to illuminate tensions between:
options: A. monetary profit optimization and regulatory bureaucratic delay.
B. aesthetic visual harmony and architectural structural resilience.
C. linguistic grammatical syntax and phonetic acoustic clarity.
D. utilitarian outcome maximization and deontological moral duty.
normal.explain: 電車難題（Trolley problem）旨在檢視效益主義極大化與道義義務之間的倫理張力。

normal.desc: 請唸出：實證上的可證偽性標準
normal.explain: empirical falsifiability (phr.)：實證上的可證偽性標準。例句：Empirical falsifiability remains the foundational touchstone of genuine scientific inquiry.（實證層面的可證偽性準則，始終是區分純粹科學探索與形上學思辨的根本試金石。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：認知失調心理狀態
normal.explain: cognitive dissonance (phr.)：認知失調心理狀態。例句：Cognitive dissonance compels individuals to rationalize contradictory ideological premises.（嚴重的認知失調心理壓力，迫使個體在面對事實真相時千方百計合理化其矛盾的意識形態。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：黑格爾辯證演進法
normal.explain: hegelian dialectics (phr.)：黑格爾辯證演進法。例句：Hegelian dialectics demonstrates how internal systemic tensions generate higher synthesis.（黑格爾的客觀唯心辯證法深刻揭示了事物內在矛盾的對立張力如何推動更高階段綜合體的形成。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：達克效應認知偏差
normal.explain: dunning kruger effect (phr.)：達克效應認知偏差。例句：The Dunning Kruger effect illustrates the cognitive blindness of acute incompetence.（心理學經典的達克效應，生動描繪了能力極度匱乏者往往深陷自我盲目高估的認知困境。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：認識論上的謙遜審慎態度
normal.explain: epistemic humility (phr.)：認識論上的謙遜審慎態度。例句：Epistemic humility demands that all theoretical models be treated as provisional.（真正的認識論謙遜品格要求我們，必須將現存的所有科學典範與理論模型皆視為暫定性的假設。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：暫時懸置哲學形上學預設
normal.explain: bracket assumptions (phr.)：暫時懸置哲學形上學預設。例句：Phenomenological inquiry requires researchers to bracket metaphysical assumptions.（現象學的直觀本質還原研究，要求哲學探索者必須徹底懸置所有未經反思的形上學外在預設。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：大腦捷思思維省力法則
normal.explain: heuristic shortcuts (phr.)：大腦捷思思維省力法則。例句：Heuristic shortcuts conserve metabolic energy while risking systemic inferential bias.（大腦內建的捷思思維捷徑雖然極大地節省了認知代謝能量，卻同時埋下了系統性推論偏誤的隱患。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：劃時代的理論典範大轉移
normal.explain: a paradigm shift (phr.)：劃時代的理論典範大轉移。例句：A profound paradigm shift dismantles classical deterministic causality.（一場劃時代的量子力學理論典範大轉移，在微觀物理領域徹底瓦解了古典牛頓力學的決定論因果律。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：認識論的與知識構建驗證本質相關的（E 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: EPISTEMIC (adj.)：認識論的與知識構建驗證本質相關的。例句：The discovery of gravitational anomalies created an acute epistemic crisis.（時空重力異常擾動現象的觀測發現，在理論物理界引發了一場尖銳的認識論信任危機。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在科學哲學中證偽假說或篡改偽造數據（F 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: FALSIFY (v.)：在科學哲學中證偽假說或篡改偽造數據。例句：A single reproducible counterexample suffices to falsify an empirical hypothesis.（僅需提出一個具備嚴格可重複檢驗性的客觀反例，便足以在邏輯上徹底證偽一項實證假說。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：認知信念或聲音之間的不協和脫節衝突（D 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: DISSONANCE (n.)：認知信念或聲音之間的不協和脫節衝突。例句：Cognitive dissonance often leads voters to rationalize political contradictions.（深層的認知失調心理狀態，往往誘使選民在面對自己支持陣營的政策自相矛盾時強行合理化。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：主張萬物皆具有終極意圖追求的目的論（T 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: TELEOLOGY (n.)：主張萬物皆具有終極意圖追求的目的論。例句：Darwinian evolutionary theory superseded theological teleology in biology.（達爾文發表的世界性物種起源進化論，在現代生物學界徹底取代了神創論色彩的超自然目的論。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：透過矛盾正反論證推演真理的辯證法（D 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: DIALECTIC (n.)：透過矛盾正反論證推演真理的辯證法。例句：Marx transformed the idealist Hegelian dialectic into historical materialism.（馬克思批判性地繼承並改造了黑格爾唯心主義辯證法的合理內核，創立了唯物史觀與辯證唯物主義。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：哲學中揚棄克服否定同時保留提升其昇華（S 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: SUBLATE (v.)：哲學中揚棄克服否定同時保留提升其昇華。例句：The new constitutional compromise managed to sublate opposing provincial claims.（這部凝聚朝野共識的全新聯邦憲法妥協案，成功揚棄並昇華了各自治行省之間原本針鋒相對的主權要求。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在學術範疇或地理邊界上劃定分野界線（D 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: DEMARCATE (v.)：在學術範疇或地理邊界上劃定分野界線。例句：Philosophers of science sought criteria to demarcate physics from metaphysics.（跨越世紀的科學哲學家們，始終在不懈探尋能夠客觀公正地劃定經驗物理學與純形上學分野的評判標準。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：現象學中懸置擱置對外部客觀存在的預斷（B 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: BRACKET (v.)：現象學中懸置擱置對外部客觀存在的預斷。例句：The researcher must bracket preconceived sociological assumptions during field work.（田野人類學調查學者在深入原始部落進行參與觀察時，必須徹底懸置自身所受的一切既有社會學偏見。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E P I S _ E M I C (與認知確定性及真理證成相關的)
normal.explain: EPISTEMIC (adj.)：與認知確定性及真理證成相關的。例句：Scientific revolutions alter the epistemic standards of rational justification.（每一次重大的科學革命爆發，都會深刻重塑並改寫人類理性證成真理的根本認識論標準。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D I _ S O _ A _ C E (信仰與客觀證據嚴重背離時的不適感)
normal.explain: DISSONANCE (n.)：信仰與客觀證據嚴重背離時的不適感。例句：Exposure to verified electoral audits triggered intense ideological dissonance.（當無可辯駁的法庭級選票鑑識審計結果公佈時，激進極端派信徒內心引發了強烈的意識形態失調。）

normal.desc: 填空題：H E _ R _ S _ I C (實用性經驗捷徑而非嚴密演繹證明)
normal.explain: HEURISTIC (adj.)：實用性經驗捷徑而非嚴密演繹證明。例句：Physicians rely on diagnostic heuristic strategies during emergency triage.（在分秒必爭的急診室搶救檢傷分類現場，值班資深主治醫師往往高度依賴臨床經驗所形成的捷思策略。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T E L E _ L O G Y (以結果與功能解釋因果機制的哲學傳統)
normal.explain: TELEOLOGY (n.)：以結果與功能解釋因果機制的哲學傳統。例句：Modern biochemistry rejects teleology in favor of mechanistic molecular kinematics.（當代前沿生物化學完全摒棄了古老的目的論思維框架，轉而完全立足於精確的分子反應動力學機制。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S _ B _ A _ E (在更高維度的綜合中實現對立面揚棄)
normal.explain: SUBLATE (v.)：在更高維度的綜合中實現對立面揚棄。例句：The emerging synthesis promises to sublate the classical and quantum divide.（前沿量子引力全像原理理論的重大突破，展現出了有望徹底揚棄並統合古典時空與微觀量子的宏偉前景。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R _ P O _ I T _ O N (作為科學推導前提條件的基本公理命題)
normal.explain: PROPOSITION (n.)：作為科學推導前提條件的基本公理命題。例句：Euclidean geometry deduces thousands of theorems from a handful of basic propositions.（古希臘歐幾里得幾何體系，僅憑藉著區區五條不證自明的初始公理命題，便嚴密演繹出了數以千計的幾何定理。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E M A _ C A T E (確立清晰的專業邊界以防止混淆)
normal.explain: DEMARCATE (v.)：確立清晰的專業邊界以防止混淆。例句：Strict methodological rules demarcate forensic pathology from speculative inference.（嚴謹苛刻的國際司法鑑識操作規範，在客觀法醫病理學與主觀臆斷推論之間劃出了一條不可踰越的紅線。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The principle of habeas corpus protects individuals from arbitrary and indefinite detention. What right is safeguarded?
options: A. The state power to sequester property without trial.
B. The fundamental right to challenge unlawful state imprisonment in court.
C. The absolute immunity of government officials from prosecution.
D. The right of corporate entities to evade public taxation.
normal.explain: 人身保護令（habeas corpus）旨在保護個人免於遭到國家機關的任意拘禁。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is essential that judicial deliberations remain insulated from partisan electoral pressures. Why?
options: A. To accelerate trial speed by removing deliberation protocols.
B. To allow ruling party donors to select appellate judges.
C. To preserve the institutional impartiality and integrity of courts.
D. To ensure that political party platforms dictate court verdicts.
normal.explain: essential that + 原形動詞 remain，確保司法評議不受黨派政治壓力干擾。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: So egregious was the prosecutorial misconduct that the judge ordered an immediate retrial. What was the reaction?
options: A. The prosecutor was immediately promoted to chief magistrate.
B. The misconduct was ignored as minor harmless error.
C. The jury was permanently imprisoned for contempt of court.
D. The court dismissed the conviction and mandated a fresh trial.
normal.explain: So egregious was... that... 倒裝凸顯檢控濫權之嚴重導致法官下令重審。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Not until the dissenting opinion was published did the public grasp the constitutional crisis. When did the public understand?
options: A. Immediately following the preliminary arraignment.
B. Before any charges had been formally brought.
C. Only after the minority judges released their critical dissent.
D. Long before the oral arguments commenced in court.
normal.explain: Not until... did... 倒裝指出只有在少數派異議意見書公佈後，公眾才看清憲法危機。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Hardly had the injunction been granted when regional developers halted construction. What happened?
options: A. Developers ignored the injunction and accelerated work.
B. The court canceled the injunction within five minutes.
C. Developers filed a successful appeal before sunrise.
D. Construction paused the very moment the court injunction was issued.
normal.explain: Hardly had... when... 倒裝描寫禁令剛一下達，開發商便立即停工。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The convention mandates that diplomatic pouches be immune from customs inspection and search. What is mandated?
options: A. Absolute legal inviolability of diplomatic mail bags.
B. Routine physical inspection of all foreign diplomatic parcels.
C. The complete commercial taxation of embassy shipments.
D. The destruction of diplomatic mail at border points.
normal.explain: mandate that + 原形虛擬式 be immune，強制外交郵袋享有絕對不可侵犯的免檢權。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Under no circumstances may evidence obtained through coercion be admitted in proceedings. What is the standard?
options: A. Coerced testimony is admissible if verified by a notary.
B. The judge has full discretion to admit torture confessions.
C. Defense attorneys must provide evidence for the prosecution.
D. A complete exclusionary bar against involuntary testimony.
normal.explain: Under no circumstances may... 倒裝闡明刑訊逼供取得的證據絕不具備證據能力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Little did the drafting committee divine that the loophole would be exploited by monopolies. What was unforeseen?
options: A. The aggressive predatory exploitation of the statutory loophole.
B. The unanimous praise the statute would receive from scholars.
C. The immediate repeal of the law by presidential decree.
D. The total irrelevance of antitrust legislation in trade.
normal.explain: Little did... divine 倒裝表示起草委員會完全未曾料到該漏洞會遭壟斷集團鑽營。

normal.desc: 【法理】The legal maxim pacta sunt servanda dictates that international treaties are binding upon signatories. What does it demand?
options: A. Only oral declarations witnessed by the pontiff carry legal validity.
B. Treaties must be faithfully and scrupulously observed in good faith.
C. Signatories may unilaterally abrogate agreements during economic recessions.
D. Treaties are merely non binding recommendations with moral force.
normal.explain: pacta sunt servanda（條約必須信守）是國際法核心準則，要求締約國必須善意嚴格恪守條約。

normal.desc: 【文法】Seldom ___ a constitutional assembly codified citizen rights with such exhaustive precision.
options: A. had been
B. did have
C. has
D. have
normal.explain: Seldom has a constitutional assembly codified... 否定倒裝句。

normal.desc: 【語用】The doctrine of stare decisis requires common law appellate tribunals to stand by precedent. What is its effect?
options: A. It mandates the automatic overruling of prior judicial decisions.
B. It allows judges to decide disputes based on personal intuition.
C. It abolishes the hierarchy between municipal and federal courts.
D. It promotes institutional consistency and predictability in rulings.
normal.explain: stare decisis（遵循先例）原則要求上訴法庭遵循既有判例以維護司法穩定與可預測性。

normal.desc: 【篇章】No sooner had the bill been signed by the sovereign ___ constitutional petitions were filed.
options: A. then
B. as
C. than
D. when
normal.explain: No sooner had... than... 固定時間倒裝。

normal.desc: 【搭配】The treaty stipulates that coastal states exercise sovereign jurisdiction over their territorial sea. What is exercised?
options: A. Temporary advisory oversight subject to foreign naval consent.
B. Shared international joint ownership without borders.
C. No regulatory control whatsoever over foreign navigation.
D. Full exclusive sovereign authority over adjacent maritime bands.
normal.explain: exercise sovereign jurisdiction 為高級法理搭配，意為行使主權管轄權。

normal.desc: 【條件】Should the respondent fail to appear, default judgment ___ entered in favor of the claimant.
options: A. will be
B. is
C. was
D. had been
normal.explain: Should the respondent fail to appear（省略 if 倒裝），主要子句使用 will be entered。

normal.desc: 【修辭】Much as legal positivists prioritize codified statutory form, moral equity cannot be wholly extirpated. What is conveyed?
options: A. Legal codes possess complete independence from ethical considerations.
B. Equity is completely obsolete in modern jurisprudence.
C. Positivism rejects the existence of written legislation.
D. Statutory law remains inextricably intertwined with moral justice.
normal.explain: Much as... 讓步倒裝：儘管法律實證主義注重制定法形式，道德衡平正義仍無法被徹底根除。

normal.desc: 【倒裝】Only by exhaustively demonstrating procedural ultra vires ___ overturn the administrative decree.
options: A. can plaintiffs
B. plaintiffs can
C. plaintiffs will
D. should plaintiffs
normal.explain: Only by... 倒裝引導情態動詞 can plaintiffs overturn。

normal.desc: 請唸出：條約必須恪守信諾（國際法基本準則）
normal.explain: pacta sunt servanda (phr.)：條約必須恪守信諾（國際法基本準則）。例句：The principle of pacta sunt servanda underpins the entire framework of international law.（條約必須信守的法理準則，構成了整部現代國際法體系的基石。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：遵循先例原則嚴格要求
normal.explain: stare decisis demands (phr.)：遵循先例原則嚴格要求。例句：The doctrine of stare decisis demands that appellate judges respect settled precedent.（遵循先例的普通法準則要求，各級上訴法院法官必須恪守既有的確立判例。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：人身保護令之司法救濟
normal.explain: habeas corpus relief (phr.)：人身保護令之司法救濟。例句：The prisoner filed a writ of habeas corpus to challenge arbitrary detention.（遭羈押者向巡迴法庭正式遞交了人身保護令狀，嚴正挑戰行政機關的任意拘禁。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：踰越法定權限之程序瑕疵
normal.explain: procedural ultra vires (phr.)：踰越法定權限之程序瑕疵。例句：The regulation was struck down on grounds of procedural ultra vires.（該項行政規章因存在超越法定管轄權限的嚴重程序瑕疵，遭最高行政法院宣告撤銷。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：在被判有罪前推定為無罪
normal.explain: presumed innocent until (phr.)：在被判有罪前推定為無罪。例句：Every accused person is presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond reasonable doubt.（任何遭到刑事起訴的被告，在未經排除合理懷疑的實質定罪之前，皆推定為無罪。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：證據排除法則嚴格禁止
normal.explain: exclusionary rule bars (phr.)：證據排除法則嚴格禁止。例句：The exclusionary rule bars the admission of unconstitutionally seized evidence.（憲法證據排除法則嚴格禁止將任何透過違憲搜查手段取得的非法證據採納為呈堂證供。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：客觀舉證責任明確歸屬於
normal.explain: burden of proof rests (phr.)：客觀舉證責任明確歸屬於。例句：The burden of proof rests entirely on the prosecution in criminal indictments.（在所有刑事公訴案件中，客觀的舉證責任毫無例外地完全落在控方檢察官身上。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：對制定法條文之嚴謹解釋
normal.explain: statutory interpretation of (phr.)：對制定法條文之嚴謹解釋。例句：Judicial statutory interpretation must harmonize legislative text with constitutional norms.（司法的制定法文義解釋，必須使實定法條文與最高憲法價值規範保持深刻的內在和諧。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：法學理論司法體系或法院判例法學（J 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: JURISPRUDENCE (n.)：法學理論司法體系或法院判例法學。例句：Comparative jurisprudence analyzes statutory doctrines across diverse civilizations.（比較法學深入研析並對照了不同文明體系之間所發展出的實定法原則。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：負責審理上訴案件之上訴法庭的（A 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: APPELLATE (adj.)：負責審理上訴案件之上訴法庭的。例句：The appellate bench reversed the lower court punitive damages award.（聯邦巡迴上訴法院正式撤銷了地方法院先前所判處的懲罰性巨額賠償判決。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：官方正式廢除條約撤銷法律或特權（A 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: ABROGATE (v.)：官方正式廢除條約撤銷法律或特權。例句：The revolutionary government moved to abrogate colonial concession agreements.（新成立的革命臨時政府採取果斷行動，正式宣布單方面廢除所有舊殖民租界不平等條約。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在後續同類判決中具約束力之司法判例（P 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: PRECEDENT (n.)：在後續同類判決中具約束力之司法判例。例句：The historic ruling established a binding precedent for digital privacy rights.（這項具有劃時代意義的歷史性判決，為數位時代公民隱私權確立了具法律約束力的先例。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：大陪審團正式簽發之刑事起訴書（I 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: INDICTMENT (n.)：大陪審團正式簽發之刑事起訴書。例句：The federal grand jury returned a twelve count indictment against the syndicate.（聯邦大陪審團正式對該跨國犯罪辛迪加的全部首腦簽發了多達十二項重罪起訴書。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：不可侵犯的不容褻瀆的崇高神聖權利（I 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: INVIOLABLE (adj.)：不可侵犯的不容褻瀆的崇高神聖權利。例句：Universal human dignity is enshrined as an inviolable constitutional principle.（普世人類尊嚴被莊嚴載入國家根本大法，確立為任何公權力皆不可侵犯的最高原則。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：侵權行為的構成民事損害賠償要件的（T 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: TORTIOUS (adj.)：侵權行為的構成民事損害賠償要件的。例句：The corporation was held liable for tortious interference with contractual relations.（該跨國公司被依法裁定應當對其惡意干預第三方商業合約關係的侵權行為承擔全額賠償。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：國會立法機關正式審議通過之成文制定法（S 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: STATUTE (n.)：國會立法機關正式審議通過之成文制定法。例句：The newly enacted environmental statute imposes criminal penalties on dumping.（最新頒布實施的國家環境保護成文法，對非法傾倒有毒危險廢物的行徑設立了嚴格刑事罰則。）

normal.desc: 填空題：J U R I S P _ U D E N C E (法理學研究與判例哲學)
normal.explain: JURISPRUDENCE (n.)：法理學研究與判例哲學。例句：Constitutional jurisprudence balances individual autonomy against collective security.（憲法法理學的永恆主題，在於在個體自由權利與集體公共安全之間尋求動態平衡。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A B _ O _ A _ E (廢除不平等舊約或法規)
normal.explain: ABROGATE (v.)：廢除不平等舊約或法規。例句：Parliament debated whether to abrogate the archaic maritime protectionism act.（國會朝野議員就應否徹底廢除這部制定於十九世紀的陳舊海事保護主義法令展開激烈辯論。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E X _ I _ P _ T E (根除洗錢犯罪溫床)
normal.explain: EXTIRPATE (v.)：根除洗錢犯罪溫床。例句：Multilateral task forces collaborated to extirpate transnational money laundering.（國際多邊反洗錢金融行動特別工作組密切合作，合力連根拔除跨國洗錢犯罪的滋生溫床。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R E C _ D E N T (具有指導性約束力的司法先例)
normal.explain: PRECEDENT (n.)：具有指導性約束力的司法先例。例句：Lower magistrates are legally bound to follow supreme court precedent.（基層地方法官在適用法律時，依法受最高法院確立的權威司法先例之嚴格拘束。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ I O _ A _ L E (神聖不可侵犯的特權)
normal.explain: INVIOLABLE (adj.)：神聖不可侵犯的特權。例句：Diplomatic missions enjoy inviolable immunity from domestic police entry.（外國駐地使領館館舍，依法享有免受駐在國任何警察力量強行進入的神聖不可侵犯豁免。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A R _ I _ R _ R Y (缺乏實質法定標準之裁量)
normal.explain: ARBITRARY (adj.)：缺乏實質法定標準之裁量。例句：Judicial review prevents administrative agencies from making arbitrary rulings.（嚴密的司法審查制度，能有效防範各行政主管機構隨心所欲地作出專斷武斷的行政處分。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T O R T _ O U S (民事侵權法律責任)
normal.explain: TORTIOUS (adj.)：民事侵權法律責任。例句：The whistleblower sued the corporation for tortious retaliatory termination.（這位勇敢的內部揭弊者正式向勞動法庭提起訴訟，控告該巨頭企業實施惡意報復性違法解雇。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The deployment of zero shot learning allows models to classify unseen categories without prior samples. What is enabled?
options: A. Complete elimination of all computational parameters from memory.
B. A requirement that users write code exclusively in binary machine language.
C. Recognition of novel categories without explicit task specific training examples.
D. Mandatory manual tagging of thousands of high resolution images.
normal.explain: 零樣本學習（Zero-Shot Learning）使模型無需特定類別的專門訓練樣本即可進行推理識別。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Latency in inference pipelines must be minimized to ensure real time conversational interactivity. What is minimized?
options: A. The accuracy of mathematical calculations performed by the processor.
B. The physical dimensions of the server rack in the data center.
C. The financial compensation paid to system software developers.
D. The time delay between user query input and model response generation.
normal.explain: 推論延遲（Inference latency）指從使用者提交查詢到模型生成回應之間的時間延遲。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Adversarial attacks introduce subtle imperceptible perturbations to fool computer vision models. What do they do?
options: A. They inject crafted visual noise that triggers catastrophic misclassification.
B. They physically dismantle the optical lenses of surveillance cameras.
C. They accelerate training throughput across cloud server clusters.
D. They clean corrupted data files from storage drives automatically.
normal.explain: 對抗性攻擊（Adversarial attacks）透過注入肉眼難以察覺的微小擾動，誘導視覺模型產生致命誤判。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Quantization compresses large neural models by reducing weight precision from thirty two bits to lower integers. What is achieved?
options: A. A massive increase in required graphical memory storage.
B. The permanent loss of all trained linguistic comprehension abilities.
C. A total shutdown of cloud computational infrastructure.
D. Reduced memory footprint and faster inference with minimal accuracy degradation.
normal.explain: 模型量化（Quantization）透過降低權重數值精度大幅縮小記憶體佔用並提升推論速度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The loss curve demonstrated rapid convergence during the initial forty training epochs. What occurred?
options: A. The error rate decreased swiftly as the model optimized its parameters.
B. The neural network stopped functioning due to hardware overheating.
C. The dataset was permanently erased from server storage drives.
D. The model became completely incapable of processing language.
normal.explain: 損失曲線（Loss curve）迅速收斂，意味著模型誤差隨著參數優化而急劇下降。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Synthetic data generation supplements scarce domain datasets by leveraging generative diffusion engines. Why is it used?
options: A. To bypass physics laboratory safety inspections during clinical trials.
B. To augment limited training pools when collecting empirical real world data is costly.
C. To replace human researchers entirely across international scientific academies.
D. To eliminate all digital software licenses in software engineering.
normal.explain: 合成數據生成（Synthetic data）在真實數據收集成本極高時，能有效擴充稀缺領域的訓練集規模。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Context window expansion allows large language models to analyze extensive legal dossiers in a single prompt. What is expanded?
options: A. The maximum number of sequence tokens the model can ingest concurrently.
B. The physical glass screen display diagonal of computer monitors.
C. The number of corporate executives attending the quarterly review.
D. The total length of power cables connected to server facilities.
normal.explain: 上下文視窗（Context window）擴展提升了模型單次能並行攝取並深入分析的文字標記容量上限。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Vector databases index dense semantic embeddings to facilitate rapid cosine similarity retrieval. What do they index?
options: A. Uncompressed video recordings from security surveillance drones.
B. High dimensional numerical representations of concepts and semantic meanings.
C. Alphabetical lists of employee names and office telephone numbers.
D. Raw audio waveforms without any computational transcription.
normal.explain: 向量資料庫（Vector database）索引高維語義嵌入向量，以實現基於餘弦相似度的高速精確檢索。

normal.desc: 【AI架構】In transformer neural architectures, what is the primary role of the self attention mechanism?
options: A. To translate text word for word using an external static dictionary.
B. To eliminate all probabilistic calculations in natural language processing.
C. To weigh the contextual relevance of all tokens in an input sequence simultaneously.
D. To compress text into a single predetermined scalar value.
normal.explain: Transformer 架構中的自注意力機制（Self-Attention）核心功能在於動態權衡輸入序列中所有標記（tokens）之間的上下文關聯權重。

normal.desc: 【AI現象】Large language models occasionally generate syntactically coherent but factually ungrounded text. What is this called?
options: A. Deterministic deduction
B. Gradient descent
C. Algorithmic compilation
D. Hallucination
normal.explain: 大型語言模型生成語法通順但事實毫無客觀依據的現象稱為「幻覺（Hallucination）」。

normal.desc: 【深度學習】During backpropagation, what does the gradient vector represent?
options: A. The direction and rate of fastest increase of the loss function with respect to weights.
B. The exact hardware temperature of the graphic processing unit cluster.
C. The total number of parameters stored in physical memory.
D. The grammatical correctness score of the model outputs.
normal.explain: 在反向傳播算法中，梯度向量（Gradient vector）代表損失函數相對於模型神經元權重增長最快的方向與變化率。

normal.desc: 【科技倫理】Algorithmic bias occurs when training datasets contain historical disparities. What is the consequence?
options: A. The hardware cluster permanently ceases mathematical operations.
B. The model outputs pure randomized ASCII noise.
C. Training time is reduced to zero milliseconds.
D. The model perpetuates and amplifies systemic societal prejudices in predictions.
normal.explain: 演算法偏見（Algorithmic bias）會使模型在預測時延續並放大訓練數據中所包含的歷史社會不公與偏見。

normal.desc: 【計算架構】Why are graphics processing units favored over central processing units for deep learning?
options: A. They possess massive parallelism suited for matrix multiplication operations.
B. They have higher single thread clock speeds for sequential tasks.
C. They store data exclusively in non volatile magnetic tape drives.
D. They operate without electrical power consumption.
normal.explain: GPU 具備大規模並行計算架構，極其擅長處理深度神經網絡訓練中的高維矩陣乘法運算。

normal.desc: 【AI訓練】Overfitting happens when a machine learning model:
options: A. operates with fewer than three biological neural connections.
B. memorizes training noise rather than learning generalizable underlying patterns.
C. fails to achieve any convergence on simple baseline benchmarks.
D. generalizes perfectly to previously unseen experimental datasets.
normal.explain: 過擬合（Overfitting）指模型死記硬背訓練集中的雜訊，而未能學會具備泛化能力的底層規律。

normal.desc: 【神經網路】What is the primary function of an activation function like ReLU in neural nodes?
options: A. To introduce non linearity allowing the network to model complex non linear functions.
B. To reset hardware memory cache after each computational epoch.
C. To restrict all output numbers strictly to negative integers.
D. To prevent human operators from inspecting internal weight matrices.
normal.explain: 激活函數（Activation function 如 ReLU）的核心使命是為神經網絡引入非線性，使其有能力擬合複雜非線性模式。

normal.desc: 【AI治理】Model interpretability and explainability are crucial in high stakes deployment because they:
options: A. guarantee that computers will never require software updates.
B. allow stakeholders to inspect the causal reasoning behind algorithmic decisions.
C. speed up raw floating point matrix operations by ten orders of magnitude.
D. eliminate the need for electricity during data center operation.
normal.explain: 模型可解釋性（Interpretability）至關重要，因為它使決策者能審查演算法判斷背後的因果因由。

normal.desc: 請唸出：自注意力計算機制
normal.explain: self attention mechanism (phr.)：自注意力計算機制。例句：The self attention mechanism calculates dynamic contextual relevance across input sequences.（自注意力機制在整個輸入序列中動態計算各詞元之間的上下文關聯度。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：演算法虛構幻覺現象
normal.explain: algorithmic hallucination (phr.)：演算法虛構幻覺現象。例句：Mitigating algorithmic hallucination is essential before deploying models in legal contexts.（在將語言模型部署至法律實務場景前，緩解演算法幻覺是不可或缺的前提。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：梯度下降最佳化演算法
normal.explain: gradient descent algorithm (phr.)：梯度下降最佳化演算法。例句：Stochastic gradient descent algorithm updates network parameters against empirical loss.（隨機梯度下降演算法依據實測損失值不斷反向迭代更新神經網絡參數。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：消解並緩解演算法偏見
normal.explain: mitigate algorithmic bias (phr.)：消解並緩解演算法偏見。例句：Engineers curated balanced demographic datasets to mitigate algorithmic bias in hiring systems.（工程團隊精選平衡的人口統計數據集，以消解招聘系統中的演算法偏見。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：矩陣乘法並行運算吞吐量
normal.explain: matrix multiplication throughput (phr.)：矩陣乘法並行運算吞吐量。例句：Tensor cores accelerate matrix multiplication throughput across deep neural network layers.（張量計算核心極大地提升了深度神經網絡各層之間的矩陣乘法運算吞吐量。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：避免發生毀滅性過擬合
normal.explain: avoid catastrophic overfitting (phr.)：避免發生毀滅性過擬合。例句：Regularization techniques like dropout are implemented to avoid catastrophic overfitting.（工程師引入了隨機丟棄等正規化技術，以避免神經網絡發生嚴重的過擬合。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：推論響應時間延遲降低
normal.explain: inference latency reduction (phr.)：推論響應時間延遲降低。例句：Model distillation and weight pruning led to dramatic inference latency reduction on smartphones.（模型蒸餾與權重剪枝技術大幅降低了深度學習模型在智慧型手機上的推論延遲。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：擴展上下文標記視窗容量
normal.explain: expand context window capacity (phr.)：擴展上下文標記視窗容量。例句：Architectural breakthroughs expand context window capacity to process entire technical books.（底層架構的重大突破，極大地擴展了模型上下文視窗處理整本技術專著的能力。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：以自注意力機制為核心的革命性神經網絡架構（T 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: TRANSFORMER (n.)：以自注意力機制為核心的革命性神經網絡架構。例句：The transformer architecture revolutionized machine translation and natural language processing.（Transformer 架構徹底革新了機器翻譯與當代自然語言處理研究領域。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：生成模型產生語義流暢但背離事實之幻覺（H 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: HALLUCINATION (n.)：生成模型產生語義流暢但背離事實之幻覺。例句：Prompt engineering and retrieval augmentation reduce algorithmic hallucination in output.（提示詞工程與檢索增強生成技術顯著降低了模型輸出中的演算法事實幻覺。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：演算法反覆迭代後達到最優解的數值收斂狀態（C 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: CONVERGENCE (n.)：演算法反覆迭代後達到最優解的數值收斂狀態。例句：The training pipeline achieved stable numerical convergence after one hundred epochs.（該神經網絡訓練流程在一萬次梯度迭代後達到了穩定的數值收斂狀態。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：將自然語言文本切分為詞元索引之分詞技術（T 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: TOKENIZATION (n.)：將自然語言文本切分為詞元索引之分詞技術。例句：Byte pair encoding tokenization efficiently handles rare terms and multilingual lexicons.（字節對編碼分詞技術能夠極其高效地處理罕見專業詞彙與跨語種詞庫。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：系統從接收請求至產出回應的時間延遲（L 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: LATENCY (n.)：系統從接收請求至產出回應的時間延遲。例句：Sub millisecond latency is mandatory for automated algorithmic financial trading platforms.（亞毫秒級的超低響應延遲，是高頻自動化演算法金融交易平台的剛性指標。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T R A N S _ O R M E R (深度學習核心注意力模型架構)
normal.explain: TRANSFORMER (n.)：深度學習核心注意力模型架構。例句：The encoder decoder transformer handles bidirectional context understanding.（編碼器-解碼器 Transformer 架構擅長處理雙向上下文深度語義理解。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O _ V E _ G E _ C E (數值優化抵達局部極小值之收斂)
normal.explain: CONVERGENCE (n.)：數值優化抵達局部極小值之收斂。例句：Adjusting learning rates prevented gradient explosion and guaranteed convergence.（靈活微調學習率有效防止了梯度爆炸，並在數學上保證了訓練過程的穩定收斂。）

normal.desc: 填空題：Q U A _ T I _ A T _ O N (權重數值精度壓縮量化)
normal.explain: QUANTIZATION (n.)：權重數值精度壓縮量化。例句：Four bit quantization reduces GPU memory usage while preserving coherence.（4-bit 深度量化技術在保持模型邏輯自洽性的同時，將顯存佔用削減了近四分之三。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T O K E N I _ A T I O N (自然語言文本切詞標記化)
normal.explain: TOKENIZATION (n.)：自然語言文本切詞標記化。例句：Specialized legal tokenization preserves statutory citations as single units.（專業法律語料分詞器，能將複雜的法條援引標記完整保留為單一詞元單位。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The syndicated loan facility was oversubscribed by twenty institutional commercial banks. What occurred?
options: A. The bank consortium rejected the loan application due to excessive leverage.
B. The company was forced to declare immediate corporate insolvency.
C. Interest rate benchmark indices declined below negative ten percent.
D. Lenders offered more capital commitments than the borrower initially requested.
normal.explain: 該筆聯貸融資案獲得二十家機構銀行的超額認購，承諾借貸資金遠超企業最初預期的融資規模。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: EBITDA margin expansion reflected disciplined operational cost containment during inflation. What expanded?
options: A. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization relative to net revenue.
B. The physical footprint of corporate warehouse distribution centers.
C. The statutory corporate income tax rate imposed by federal tax agencies.
D. The total number of legal lawsuits filed by environmental advocacy groups.
normal.explain: 息稅折舊攤銷前盈餘率（EBITDA margin）擴張，體現了企業在通膨環境下嚴格控制營運支出的卓越成效。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The tender offer presented a thirty percent premium over the prevailing volume weighted average price. What was offered?
options: A. A settlement agreement terminating all overseas intellectual property rights.
B. An acquisition bid significantly above the current market trading benchmark.
C. A thirty percent discount penalizing shareholders who redeem stock early.
D. An ultimatum requiring immediate dismissal of the entire executive committee.
normal.explain: 這項公開收購要約（Tender offer）提出了高於現行成交量加權平均股價 30% 的溢價，旨在吸引股東售股。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Capital expenditure guidance was revised downward to preserve free cash flow generation. Why?
options: A. To safeguard liquid cash reserves by curtailing investments in long term physical assets.
B. To purchase luxury executive aircraft for cross continental business trips.
C. To accelerate the construction of ten additional manufacturing mega factories.
D. To eliminate all financial accounting software licenses in administrative offices.
normal.explain: 調降資本支出預算指引（CapEx），旨在藉由縮減長期實體資產投資以保護企業自由現金流的健康造血能力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The convertible bond offering carried a two percent coupon with a twenty five percent strike premium. What was issued?
options: A. An uncollateralized payday loan contract for junior corporate employees.
B. A hybrid debt security paying low interest with the option to convert into equity shares.
C. A high interest sovereign Treasury note guaranteed by the central monetary authority.
D. A perpetual preferred stock tranche without any voting rights or dividend accruals.
normal.explain: 該可轉換公司債提供 2% 的票面利息，並附帶溢價 25% 轉換為普通股的認股權利。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A clawback provision forced former executives to return incentive bonuses following accounting restatements. What occurred?
options: A. The national treasury reimbursed the company for all legal defense fees.
B. Shareholders surrendered their stock certificates to municipal government archives.
C. Unjustified compensation was recovered after financial reporting irregularities were exposed.
D. The company paid triple compensation packages to departed management personnel.
normal.explain: 在財務報表爆出會計差錯並重編後，追回條款（Clawback provision）強制涉事高管退還此前領取的不當獎金。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The covenant breach triggered an immediate cross default clause across parallel credit facilities. What happened?
options: A. The enterprise was granted an automatic five year tax holiday by the government.
B. Violating terms in one debt agreement triggered default status across all related borrowings.
C. The company was awarded an upgraded triple A credit rating by international rating agencies.
D. All outstanding commercial bank debt was forgiven by international creditor banks.
normal.explain: 一項借貸合約中的違約條款觸發了交叉違約（Cross-default），導致該企業所有的並行信貸融資全數陷入違約。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The merger arbitrage spread widened as regulatory antitrust clearance appeared increasingly dubious. What widened?
options: A. The salary gap between entry level interns and senior department directors.
B. The total number of administrative staff members employed across divisions.
C. The price differential between the target company stock and the proposed buyout offer.
D. The physical distance between corporate regional distribution centers.
normal.explain: 由於反壟斷反托拉斯監管審批前景不明，併購套利價差（Merger arbitrage spread）顯著走闊。

normal.desc: 【企業併購】In corporate acquisitions, what is the primary purpose of conducting due diligence?
options: A. To organize celebratory banquets for junior sales representatives.
B. To immediately terminate all existing supplier contracts without review.
C. To publish fabricated marketing brochures for retail customers.
D. To rigorously audit financial liabilities, legal exposure, and operational risks before finalizing a transaction.
normal.explain: 盡職調查（Due diligence）的核心目的，在於完成交易前全面審計目標企業的財務負債、法律訴訟風險與營運漏洞。

normal.desc: 【公司治理】A poison pill provision is adopted by a corporate board primarily to:
options: A. deter hostile takeovers by diluting the acquiring entity's equity stake.
B. distribute toxic agricultural pesticides to corporate branch offices.
C. grant unconditional executive bonuses during corporate bankruptcy proceedings.
D. mandate daily physical exercise for minority shareholders.
normal.explain: 毒藥丸條款（Poison pill）主要用於抵禦惡意收購，透過向現有股東折價增發股票以稀釋收購方的股權比例。

normal.desc: 【財務估值】Discounted cash flow analysis determines an enterprise's intrinsic value by:
options: A. measuring the historical inflation rate of foreign currencies exclusively.
B. projecting future cash flows and discounting them back using a weighted average cost of capital.
C. counting the physical coins stored inside corporate retail registers.
D. calculating the total square footage of executive office spaces.
normal.explain: 現金流折現法（DCF）透過預測企業未來自由現金流，並以加權平均資本成本（WACC）折現來評估企業內在價值。

normal.desc: 【資本結構】A leveraged buyout relies predominantly on which mechanism for financing?
options: A. Significant debt issuance secured against the target company's assets and future cash flows.
B. Unconditional cash subsidies provided by foreign philanthropic foundations.
C. Purely barter exchange of industrial surplus inventory goods.
D. Direct public crowdsourcing on microblogging platforms.
normal.explain: 槓桿收購（LBO）主要依賴以目標企業自身的資產與未來現金流為抵押所發行的高比例債券進行融資收購。

normal.desc: 【股權激勵】Restricted stock units are awarded to corporate leadership subject to:
options: A. mandatory conversion into physical gold bullion bars within twenty four hours.
B. vesting schedules tied to retention tenure or predefined performance milestones.
C. immediate unconditional liquid payout on the first employment day.
D. complete forfeiture if the overall national gross domestic product increases.
normal.explain: 限制性股票單元（RSUs）受制於歸屬期程（Vesting schedule），通常需滿足特定任職年限或營運績效指標方可正式兌現。

normal.desc: 【反壟斷】Antitrust regulators scrutinize horizontal mergers primarily to prevent:
options: A. the standard payment of corporate income tax to municipal authorities.
B. the simultaneous operation of physical retail stores and digital websites.
C. undue market concentration that diminishes consumer competition and inflates pricing.
D. the hiring of foreign language translators in executive offices.
normal.explain: 反壟斷監管機構重點審查橫向併購，以防止特定產業出現過度市場集中，進而扼殺市場競爭並推高終端商品定價。

normal.desc: 【股東權利】Proxy voting empowers corporate shareholders who cannot attend annual meetings to:
options: A. seize physical control of company delivery logistics vehicles.
B. delegate their voting rights to an authorized representative or voting committee.
C. veto the official sovereign currency of the national central bank.
D. demand an immediate audit of personal banking records of fellow attendees.
normal.explain: 委託書投票（Proxy voting）賦予無法親自出席股東大會的投資人，將其表決權委託給代理人代為行使的合法權利。

normal.desc: 【破產重整】Chapter eleven corporate reorganization enables an insolvent company to:
options: A. auction all executive clothing to private collectors online.
B. cease all customer telephone support operations permanently.
C. restructure its debt obligations while continuing normal operational business under court supervision.
D. immediately extinguish all obligations to creditors without any judicial oversight.
normal.explain: 第十一章重組程序（Chapter 11）允許陷入財務困境的企業在法院監督與破產保護下重整債務，同時維持正常商業營運。

normal.desc: 請唸出：企業收購前的全面盡職調查
normal.explain: corporate due diligence (phr.)：企業收購前的全面盡職調查。例句：Corporate due diligence uncovers hidden balance sheet liabilities before merger execution.（收購前嚴格的企業盡職調查，能在併購正式簽約前挖掘出隱蔽的資產負債表潛在負債。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：防範惡意收購的防禦策略
normal.explain: hostile takeover defense (phr.)：防範惡意收購的防禦策略。例句：The board deployed a poison pill as a hostile takeover defense against corporate raiders.（董事會部署了毒藥丸策略，作為抵禦惡意企業狙擊手收購的強硬防禦盾牌。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：高負債槓桿併購收購交易
normal.explain: leveraged buyout transaction (phr.)：高負債槓桿併購收購交易。例句：Private equity sponsors structured the leveraged buyout transaction with senior secured loans.（私募股權基金透過優先有擔保貸款，精心搭建了這筆高槓桿收購交易的融資架構。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：多銀行聯合銀團授信額度
normal.explain: syndicated credit facility (phr.)：多銀行聯合銀團授信額度。例句：The multinational borrower secured a multi billion dollar syndicated credit facility.（該跨國巨頭企業成功敲定了一筆高達數十億美元的多銀行聯合銀團授信額度。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：維權股東與避險基金施壓
normal.explain: activist investor pressure (phr.)：維權股東與避險基金施壓。例句：Corporate executives yielded to activist investor pressure and announced a share repurchase program.（管理層最終向維權投資機構的強大壓力妥協，正式宣佈實施大規模庫藏股回購計畫。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：併購套利交易市場利差
normal.explain: merger arbitrage spread (phr.)：併購套利交易市場利差。例句：Hedge funds capitalized on the widening merger arbitrage spread amid regulatory antitrust scrutiny.（避險基金緊扣反壟斷審查期間顯著擴大的併購套利利差，進行大舉多空對沖佈局。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：高管不當薪酬獎金追回條款
normal.explain: executive clawback clause (phr.)：高管不當薪酬獎金追回條款。例句：The compensation committee invoked the executive clawback clause following the accounting audit.（薪酬委員會在外部會計審計發現重大漏洞後，果斷啟動了高管不當獎金追回條款。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：股權激勵歸屬期程關鍵里程碑
normal.explain: vesting schedule milestone (phr.)：股權激勵歸屬期程關鍵里程碑。例句：Stock options unlock sequentially according to a four year vesting schedule milestone.（高管股票期權將嚴格按照既定的四年歸屬期程關鍵里程碑，逐年分批予以解鎖。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：增發新股導致既有股東股權份額之稀釋（D 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: DILUTION (n.)：增發新股導致既有股東股權份額之稀釋。例句：Uncontrolled share issuances cause substantial equity dilution for existing retail investors.（無節制地增發新股，將導致既有散戶投資人的股權持有比例遭受嚴重稀釋。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：企業償還長期全部債務的償債資產實力（S 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: SOLVENCY (n.)：企業償還長期全部債務的償債資產實力。例句：Credit rating analysts closely track corporate solvency ratios during interest rate hikes.（在央行持續升息的週期中，信用評級分析師會極其密切地追蹤企業的長期償債能力。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：用於向金融機構借貸的抵押擔保品（C 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: COLLATERAL (n.)：用於向金融機構借貸的抵押擔保品。例句：Commercial real estate assets were pledged as loan collateral for the corporate borrowing.（企業將旗下持有的優質商業不動產，抵押給銀行作為該筆大額借貸的擔保品。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：無形資產或長期債務本金的逐期分攤攤銷（A 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: AMORTIZATION (n.)：無形資產或長期債務本金的逐期分攤攤銷。例句：Goodwill amortization rules diverge significantly between international accounting systems.（商譽攤銷的會計確認規則，在國際財務報告準則與各國標準之間存在顯著分歧。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：企業破產時將全數財產清算拍賣折現（L 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: LIQUIDATION (n.)：企業破產時將全數財產清算拍賣折現。例句：Unsecured bondholders typically recover negligible value during forced corporate liquidation.（在企業面臨強制破產清算的極端處境下，無擔保債權人通常難以收回實質資產。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D I L U _ I O N (增發新股之股權稀釋)
normal.explain: DILUTION (n.)：增發新股之股權稀釋。例句：Convertible bonds converted into stock triggered equity dilution for founders.（可轉換公司債轉為股票時，對初創創始團隊的股權比例產生了一定程度的稀釋。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O _ L A _ E _ A L (獲取信貸之擔保抵押物)
normal.explain: COLLATERAL (n.)：獲取信貸之擔保抵押物。例句：Secured creditors claim priority over pledged asset collateral in bankruptcy.（在破產程序中，有擔保債權人對當初所質押的擔保資產享有絕對優先的受償分配權。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D I _ E S _ I T _ R E (剝離非核心業務部門)
normal.explain: DIVESTITURE (n.)：剝離非核心業務部門。例句：Antitrust regulators demanded the divestiture of regional telecom assets.（反托拉斯競爭主管機構發出勒令，要求收購方必須將特定區域的電信資產予以全數剝離。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A M O R T I _ A T I O N (專利技術等無形資產攤銷)
normal.explain: AMORTIZATION (n.)：專利技術等無形資產攤銷。例句：The finance team scheduled annual amortization of newly acquired software patents.（財務管理團隊將新近併購取得的軟體技術專利，納入年度無形資產折舊與分期攤銷計劃中。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The red team executed a spear phishing campaign targeting finance department credentials. What was done?
options: A. They sent deceptive, highly tailored emails designed to trick employees into divulging sensitive logins.
B. They organized an outdoor charity marathon event for administrative corporate personnel.
C. They physically rewired the electrical grid supplying power to the commercial office building.
D. They installed free open source graphic editing software across all desktop computers.
normal.explain: 紅隊（Red team）發起了一場極具針對性的魚叉式釣魚攻擊（Spear phishing），企圖誘騙財務高管交出關鍵核心帳密憑證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The telemetry revealed rapid lateral movement utilizing stolen privileged domain credentials. What was detected?
options: A. Corporate employees transferred their personal files to encrypted thumb drives for safekeeping.
B. The attacker moved from an initial entry endpoint across other internal servers using admin rights.
C. The internal network cables were re routed through physical ceiling ventilation ducts.
D. The operating system successfully updated all antivirus signatures without human intervention.
normal.explain: 威脅遙測日誌揭示，攻擊者已利用竊取的特權網域帳號，從邊緣失陷節點高速向企業內網的核心伺服器發動橫向移動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A ransomware operator demanded fifty bitcoins while threatening to exfiltrate proprietary source code. What happened?
options: A. The commercial bank refunded all transaction processing fees incurred over the previous decade.
B. All computer files were automatically converted into open source educational textbooks online.
C. The attacker encrypted operational databases and demanded ransom under threat of a public data leak.
D. The company received an unsolicited philanthropic monetary grant from an anonymous benefactor.
normal.explain: 勒索軟體集團加密了企業的關鍵業務資料庫，並以公開其核心原始碼為威脅，勒索五十枚比特幣贖金。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A software supply chain vulnerability in a popular logging library triggered emergency patching. What happened?
options: A. An overseas shipping harbor experienced delays unloading container ships carrying raw steel.
B. A flaw within third party dependency code compromised thousands of downstream client software applications.
C. A delivery truck transporting physical computer hard drives broke down on an interstate highway.
D. A corporate supplier canceled a contracted shipment of plastic office stationery supplies.
normal.explain: 一項存在於廣泛引用的底層開源日誌庫中的軟體供應鏈漏洞，引發了全球無數下游企業軟體系統的緊急修補浪潮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The cryptographic hash of the compiled executable file did not match the vendor signature. What was indicated?
options: A. The software program had won an international award for user interface graphic design.
B. The file was permanently translated into archaic spoken languages from the classical antiquity era.
C. The file was tampered with, corrupted, or altered by an unauthorized third party during distribution.
D. The computer processor executed the calculation at speeds exceeding international safety limits.
normal.explain: 編譯後二進位執行檔的密碼學雜湊值（Hash）與官方數位簽章不符，表明該安裝檔在分發過程中已被篡改或植入後門。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Security information and event management software ingested ten million logs per hour. What was its function?
options: A. To convert historical corporate email archives into printed paper bound library encyclopedias.
B. To measure the precise room temperature inside server equipment cooling cabinets.
C. To automatically issue paychecks to corporate software engineering contractors twice a month.
D. To aggregate, normalize, and analyze real time operational telemetry to detect anomalous threats.
normal.explain: 安全性資訊與事件管理系統（SIEM）每小時匯聚分析數千萬條運算日誌，旨在透過大數據即時比對挖掘潛在的異常威脅。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Data exfiltration occurred over an obscure covert DNS tunneling channel across six months. What occurred?
options: A. The municipal postal service delivered confidential letters to wrong residential addresses repeatedly.
B. Internet service providers upgraded fiber optic undersea telecommunication transmission speeds.
C. Sensitive corporate intelligence was slowly and stealthily leaked outside the network using DNS packets.
D. The company expanded its domain name portfolio to include fifty additional localized country extensions.
normal.explain: 機密資料在長達半年的時間內，透過高度隱匿的 DNS 隧道傳輸通道被悄悄滲透竊取至外部境外伺服器。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Air gapped computers containing uranium enrichment centrifuge designs were isolated from the internet. How?
options: A. They were connected to high speed fiber optic lines directly linked to international public servers.
B. They were scheduled to reboot automatically every five minutes to refresh their web browser cache.
C. They were protected exclusively by posting warning signs on the physical computer display plastic frames.
D. They were physically disconnected from all external wired and wireless network telecommunications.
normal.explain: 儲存有濃縮鈾離心機圖紙的實體隔離電腦（Air-gapped），透過徹底切斷所有有線與無線網路連結，確保與公網物理隔絕。

normal.desc: 【網路安全】A Zero Trust security architecture is fundamentally premised on the principle of:
options: A. never trust, always verify, requiring continuous identity and device authentication.
B. granting unconditional internal network access to anyone possessing an employee email.
C. storing all corporate encryption master keys on unencrypted public web servers.
D. disabling all operating system firewall software to expedite internet bandwidth speeds.
normal.explain: 零信任架構（Zero Trust）的核心原則為「永不信任，始終驗證」，要求對所有存取請求進行持續的身分認證與設備安全檢驗。

normal.desc: 【威脅分析】An Advanced Persistent Threat typically distinguishes itself by:
options: A. deleting non essential temporary text files to optimize local hardware storage.
B. prolonged, stealthy, and targeted multi phase espionage orchestrated by state actors or cartels.
C. sending randomized commercial advertisement emails to millions of personal accounts.
D. temporarily changing the desktop wallpaper of infected personal computer devices.
normal.explain: 進階持續性威脅（APT）通常由國家級組織或大型犯罪集團策劃，具備長期隱匿、目標明確與多階段深度滲透等特徵。

normal.desc: 【攻擊手法】A Man in the Middle attack compromises communication confidentiality by:
options: A. forcing computer monitors to display only black and white video transmissions.
B. stealing physical office desks from corporate administration facilities at midnight.
C. secretly intercepting, eavesdropping on, or altering messages between two communicating parties.
D. physically cutting underground fiber optic cables with industrial construction machinery.
normal.explain: 中間人攻擊（MitM）藉由在通訊雙方之間暗中攔截、竊聽或篡改傳輸內容，徹底破壞了數據通訊的機密性與完整性。

normal.desc: 【弱點管理】A Zero Day vulnerability presents an acute security hazard because:
options: A. it automatically repairs all corrupted files across internal network storage volumes.
B. no official security patch or mitigation exists from the vendor at the time of active exploitation.
C. it occurs exclusively on the thirtieth day of February every four calendar years.
D. it can only affect computer hardware devices manufactured prior to nineteen ninety.
normal.explain: 零日漏洞（Zero-Day）意味著在漏洞已被駭客主動利用於攻擊時，官方軟體廠商尚未推出任何安全修補程式或防護對策。

normal.desc: 【資料法規】Under the General Data Protection Regulation, the right to erasure allows citizens to:
options: A. seize physical control of commercial data center server hardware clusters.
B. prohibit international news organizations from reporting on global weather patterns.
C. request that controllers delete their personal telemetry and identifying data without undue delay.
D. demand that government authorities shut down all commercial internet providers entirely.
normal.explain: 歐盟通用資料保護條例（GDPR）所賦予的被遺忘權（Right to erasure），允許公民要求數據控制者依法即時刪除其個人隱私資料。

normal.desc: 【雲端安全】A Distributed Denial of Service attack disrupts internet service availability by:
options: A. stealing physical hard drives from high security corporate server storage facilities.
B. forcing database software to convert all numerical records into Roman numerals.
C. silently rewriting software source code comments during nightly compilation routines.
D. overwhelming target servers with massive torrents of coordinated traffic from distributed botnets.
normal.explain: 分散式阻斷服務攻擊（DDoS）透過調動全球受感染的殭屍網路（Botnet），向目標伺服器傾瀉巨量惡意流量以癱瘓其對外服務。

normal.desc: 【事件應變】In incident response frameworks, the containment phase focuses immediately on:
options: A. deleting all event log files to clear server storage space for ongoing operations.
B. purchasing brand new office furniture for administrative customer service personnel.
C. isolating compromised host systems to prevent lateral movement and further operational infection.
D. issuing celebratory press releases to international media concerning technical innovation.
normal.explain: 在資安應變架構中，圍堵階段（Containment）的首要任務在於即時隔離失陷的主機節點，以防範攻擊者橫向移動至內網核心。

normal.desc: 【密碼應用】End to end encryption ensures that sensitive communication data:
options: A. is converted into plaintext audio files stored openly on international public cloud platforms.
B. is automatically transmitted to foreign intelligence services for grammatical editing.
C. can be unlocked by any third party telecommunication routing provider upon request.
D. can be decrypted exclusively by the intended communicating endpoints, remaining opaque to intermediaries.
normal.explain: 端到端加密（E2EE）確保只有合法的通訊兩端能夠解密對話內容，任何經手的網路服務商與中間節點皆完全無法窺探原文。

normal.desc: 請唸出：零信任安全防禦體系架構
normal.explain: zero trust architecture (phr.)：零信任安全防禦體系架構。例句：Enterprises migrate away from perimeter defenses toward a unified zero trust architecture.（各大跨國企業正紛紛告別傳統邊界防禦，全面轉向架構更為嚴密的統一零信任安全體系。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：國家級進階持續性滲透威脅
normal.explain: advanced persistent threat (phr.)：國家級進階持續性滲透威脅。例句：Intelligence agencies tracked the advanced persistent threat back to state sponsored actors.（國家情報機構透過多方追蹤溯源，確認該進階持續性威脅係由特定國家級黑客組織所策動。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：針對高階主管之魚叉式釣魚攻擊
normal.explain: spear phishing campaign (phr.)：針對高階主管之魚叉式釣魚攻擊。例句：The sophisticated spear phishing campaign bypassed basic email domain security filters.（這場手法精密的魚叉式釣魚定向攻擊，成功繞過了企業電子郵件網域基礎防護過濾器。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：隱蔽的機密資料外流滲透通道
normal.explain: data exfiltration channel (phr.)：隱蔽的機密資料外流滲透通道。例句：Network monitoring flagged a suspicious data exfiltration channel routing through cloud proxies.（網路監控系統即時捕獲了一條偽裝成正常雲端代理請求的隱蔽機密資料外流滲透通道。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：內網橫向移動攻擊威脅偵測
normal.explain: lateral movement detection (phr.)：內網橫向移動攻擊威脅偵測。例句：Behavioral analysis models triggered an alert upon lateral movement detection in the server farm.（使用者行為異常分析模型，在伺服器機房內部偵測到攻擊者企圖橫向移動時立即拉響了警報。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：端到端不可攔截加密傳輸
normal.explain: end to end encryption (phr.)：端到端不可攔截加密傳輸。例句：Activists rely on end to end encryption to shield confidential human rights reporting.（各國人權工作者極度依賴端到端不可攔截的加密傳輸技術，以保護極度敏感的現場調查報告。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：緩衝區溢位記憶體破壞利用
normal.explain: buffer overflow exploitation (phr.)：緩衝區溢位記憶體破壞利用。例句：Modern operating systems deploy address space layout randomization to stop buffer overflow exploitation.（當代主流作業系統普遍部署了位址空間配置隨機化技術，以阻斷惡意緩衝區溢位利用。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：封包偽裝隱蔽隧道傳輸協定
normal.explain: covert tunneling protocol (phr.)：封包偽裝隱蔽隧道傳輸協定。例句：Malware bypassed firewalls by encoding binary payloads inside a covert tunneling protocol.（惡意病毒軟體將其二進位攻擊載荷偽裝編碼於隱蔽隧道協定中，成功穿透了外層防火牆。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：未經授權將機密數據向外部網路竊取與滲透（E 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: EXFILTRATION (n.)：未經授權將機密數據向外部網路竊取與滲透。例句：Data exfiltration defenses block unauthorized outbound encrypted transfer protocols.（完善的資料外洩防禦系統，能精準攔截任何未經授權的外部加密數據傳輸行為。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：軟體或硬體中可被攻擊者利用的安全缺陷漏洞（V 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: VULNERABILITY (n.)：軟體或硬體中可被攻擊者利用的安全缺陷漏洞。例句：A critical vulnerability in the cryptographic handshake permitted remote code execution.（密碼學握手協定中存在的一項嚴重漏洞，允許遠端未授權攻擊者直接執行任意代碼。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：傳統網路防禦中劃分內外網的安全邊界（P 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: PERIMETER (n.)：傳統網路防禦中劃分內外網的安全邊界。例句：Relying solely on a legacy network perimeter is obsolete in distributed remote work.（在遠距辦公成為常態的當下，僅僅依賴傳統內外網邊界防禦已經完全跟不上時代。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：加密受害者資料並以此索要高額贖金的勒索病毒（R 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: RANSOMWARE (n.)：加密受害者資料並以此索要高額贖金的勒索病毒。例句：Targeted ransomware campaigns caused catastrophic outages across regional public hospitals.（極具針對性的勒索病毒惡意攻擊，導致區域大型公立醫療系統的各項業務全面癱瘓。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：證明公鑰合法性與身分的數位安全憑證（C 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: CERTIFICATE (n.)：證明公鑰合法性與身分的數位安全憑證。例句：An invalid TLS certificate immediately prompts modern browsers to terminate the session.（一旦伺服器出示了無效的 TLS 數位憑證，當代瀏覽器將立即中斷該次通訊對話。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E X F I L T _ A T I O N (機密資產非法滲透外洩)
normal.explain: EXFILTRATION (n.)：機密資產非法滲透外洩。例句：DLP software alerts administrators to unauthorized database exfiltration.（資料外洩防護軟體（DLP）在偵測到未經授權的資料庫外流滲透時，會即時拉響警報。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P E _ I _ E _ E R (傳統企業網路邊界安全)
normal.explain: PERIMETER (n.)：傳統企業網路邊界安全。例句：Cloud migration dissolved the rigid boundaries of the internal corporate perimeter.（企業大步向雲端架構遷移，徹底瓦解了過往劃分壁壘分明的傳統內部企業安全防線邊界。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S A _ D B _ X _ N G (未知程式沙盒隔離測試)
normal.explain: SANDBOXING (n.)：未知程式沙盒隔離測試。例句：The security gateway performs automated sandboxing on suspicious email attachments.（安全閘道會自動對所有來源可疑的電子郵件附件，進行嚴密的虛擬沙盒隔離動態測試。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R A N S O _ W A R E (勒索加密惡意軟體)
normal.explain: RANSOMWARE (n.)：勒索加密惡意軟體。例句：Regular offline immutable backups neutralize the catastrophic threat of ransomware.（落實常態化的離線防篡改數據備份機制，能從容化解任何勒索病毒帶來的毀滅性打擊。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The phase three trial demonstrated a ninety percent relative risk reduction in severe disease. What was demonstrated?
options: A. That the pharmaceutical firm surrendered all corporate profits to charitable international organizations.
B. Significant clinical efficacy across thousands of diverse patients compared against the control group.
C. That ten percent of trial participants grew additional physical limbs during the investigation.
D. That the medication permanently eliminated the biological need for human sleep.
normal.explain: 三期臨床試驗在數千名多元受試者中，展現出相較安慰劑對照組重症相對風險降低 90% 的顯著臨床保護效力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The genomic sequencer identified an oncogenic driver mutation in the epidermal growth factor receptor. What was found?
options: A. An ancient viral remnant that provides immunity against high altitude mountain sickness.
B. A synthetic mathematical equation encoded within non coding chromosomal DNA.
C. A specific DNA alteration actively triggering uncontrolled cancer cell proliferation.
D. A harmless cosmetic variation affecting the natural color of human fingernails.
normal.explain: 高通量基因定序儀在表皮生長因子受體（EGFR）中，精準揪出了導致癌細胞失控瘋狂惡性增殖的原發致癌驅動基因突變。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Off target cleavage remains a critical safety obstacle in therapeutic CRISPR in vivo deployments. What is the risk?
options: A. The physical explosion of diagnostic testing equipment inside cleanroom facilities.
B. The permanent loss of all trained cognitive memories in the human cerebral cortex.
C. The accidental creation of biological viruses resistant to ambient atmospheric pressure.
D. The unintended cutting of non target DNA sequences that could disrupt essential tumor suppressor genes.
normal.explain: 在 CRISPR 體內基因治療中，脫靶切割（Off-target cleavage）是核心安全隱患，其可能誤傷非目標正常基因甚至誘發新的致癌風險。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Informed consent documentation must ensure participants understand all investigational experimental risks. What is mandated?
